nodes.norm_label: health_set_relaxed 集合精确匹配移除

nodes.norm_label: 跨仓人工确认点 t27(pre-write snapshot + sha256 + accepted/rejected/no_response)

nodes.norm_label: current-close-projection 改写:k2 为 current authority、k5 仅 history readback

nodes.label: dispatch_state 提升到配对聚合面顶层
nodes.norm_label: dispatch_state 提升到配对聚合面顶层

nodes.norm_label: focus 复审五项输入一次性内存组装(不落盘)

nodes.norm_label: oi-26 freshness 四类口径:a/k5 保留、b/d use-site 删除

nodes.norm_label: 守卫基线不劣化(markdownlint / record-paths / structure 动态 before-after-delta)

nodes.norm_label: handoff-t2-001~007 登记与移交(006 记 superseded/accepted closed)

nodes.norm_label: 异源判定按底层模型 identity.model(非 profile 键)

nodes.norm_label: 审查去重键五维 identity (stage, phase_id, track, review_kind, origin)

nodes.norm_label: risk_close 等值判定 + delivery.quality_gaps 收口

nodes.norm_label: detail bundle 补 skills/ lens(3 条 skill.md)

nodes.norm_label: stage-runtime preflight 三类校验(protocol_invalid 三字段 ≤5s)

nodes.norm_label: t-11 请求身份协议版本(request_id_conflict / 24h ttl 内可重跑)

nodes.norm_label: 任务级三条总账:m4 additions-deletions、m3 记录文件数、no-reader 对象数

nodes.norm_label: tier-c 删除面(quality-verify.v1 schema / 对象图 / registry tombstone)

nodes.norm_label: verify 执行端读 review_result_ref 并分区结论

nodes.norm_label: 写口三项核对(task_id + 工作区路径 + 待写字节)与字节比对

nodes.norm_label: debate v2(4 独立子代理 + 文件 mailbox,跨宿主)

nodes.label: deep-research 技能（R0-R5 调研契约 + research-report.v1 落盘）
nodes.norm_label: deep-research 技能(r0-r5 调研契约 + research-report.v1 落盘)
nodes.rationale: D-401/D-402：旧调研条款无完成标准、跳过只需一句话、无读原文要求；固化为 R0 规划→R1 迭代检索→R2 并行深读→R3 三角测量→R4 research-report.v1 content-addressed 落盘 task_dir→R5 独立复核，含停止条件预算。

nodes.label: 争议判定（共识 ∪ 分歧）与三态矩阵
nodes.norm_label: 争议判定(共识 ∪ 分歧)与三态矩阵
nodes.rationale: D-103：现有 findings 聚合只有 cluster 级 disposition、无 disputed 概念；争议=共识（≥2 provider 独立提出）∪分歧（severity/evidence_kind 冲突或一提出一沉默），标注只落 provenance 层，reportable findings 语义不变。

nodes.norm_label: make-decision 执行模型(m/s/b/p,主会话=调度器)

nodes.norm_label: material_id 算法一致性修复(对齐 broker canonical)

nodes.label: 审查材料宿主路径脱敏 + 身份降级错误码保留
nodes.norm_label: 审查材料宿主路径脱敏 + 身份降级错误码保留

nodes.label: 问答工具化（结构化问题卡与答复 IO 契约）
nodes.norm_label: 问答工具化(结构化问题卡与答复 io 契约)

nodes.label: 红蓝两次组请求（同一逻辑 review fact，pair_id/role）
nodes.norm_label: 红蓝两次组请求(同一逻辑 review fact,pair_id/role)

nodes.norm_label: 调研工具路由(外部 anysearch / 内部 git+rg+ast-grep)

nodes.label: accepted_risk 公共通道（confirm 语义扩展）
nodes.norm_label: accepted_risk 公共通道(confirm 语义扩展)
nodes.rationale: D-203：kernel.acceptReviewRisk 无 public 路由、needs_human 无写回位置，闭环最后一环断裂；复用既有 confirm 语义扩展而非新增公共 behavior 名，以守住「公共行为只有七类」红线。

nodes.label: 状态转移矩阵（审查/对话/调研失败与降级语义）
nodes.norm_label: 状态转移矩阵(审查/对话/调研失败与降级语义)

nodes.label: 争议对话闭环（Talk3 强绑定 + 新增 Talk4）
nodes.norm_label: 争议对话闭环(talk3 强绑定 + 新增 talk4)

nodes.label: 测试硬规则：只跑受影响针对性测试
nodes.norm_label: 测试硬规则:只跑受影响针对性测试
nodes.rationale: D-607/F-021：用户反复抱怨全量回归浪费时间；根因=规则只在 docs/standard-workflow.md:310 而未被写入子代理指令，故提升为 AGENTS.md 硬规则并禁止无范围全量 vitest/npm run test:safe。

nodes.label: Constitution Check（F1-F11/Q1-Q3/S1-S8 逐条对照）
nodes.rationale: 以 CONSTITUTION.md SHA-256 与 checklist hash 绑定；三个 new 机制（mailbox/deep-research/告警 checker）均完成 F10 四问，两个新控制面（问答工具卡、confirm 语义扩展）登记 owner/consumer/删除条件。

nodes.label: DEC-001 红蓝 pair 语义落点（schema 加可选 pair_id/role/disputed）
nodes.norm_label: dec-001 红蓝 pair 语义落点(schema 加可选 pair_id/role/disputed)
nodes.rationale: 选既有 schema 加可选字段而非 v2 schema（无新机器消费者、违反 X-003 边界）或旁路文件（双写真相）；可选字段缺省不影响既有消费方，是最小充分改动。

nodes.label: DEC-002 material_id 算法对齐 broker canonical
nodes.norm_label: dec-002 material_id 算法对齐 broker canonical
nodes.rationale: 不修则严格冻结路径真实往返 MATERIAL_INCOMPLETE；只改 WH 侧（broker 为外部仓只读参照系），拒绝永久兼容 bridge 以守治理边界。

nodes.label: DEC-003 accepted_risk 公共通道 = confirm 语义扩展
nodes.norm_label: dec-003 accepted_risk 公共通道 = confirm 语义扩展
nodes.rationale: 拒绝新增公共 behavior 名（公共行为只有七类，宪法红线）与私有流程节点（用户授权必须走公共通道）；复用既有授权语义，不扩张公共行为面。

nodes.label: DEC-004 build-spec findings 处置对话复用 spec-clarify
nodes.norm_label: dec-004 build-spec findings 处置对话复用 spec-clarify
nodes.rationale: T-023 收窄早期 D-202 措辞：talk-with-zhipeng 不进 build-spec、不新增技能；复用 spec-clarify 承载「基于争议发现的规格澄清批次」，closure 仅契约文本调整、L9 常量与 grill 独占不动，零新控制面。

nodes.label: DEC-005 debate mailbox 文件格式（单消息单文件 JSON）
nodes.norm_label: dec-005 debate mailbox 文件格式(单消息单文件 json)
nodes.rationale: 共享文件系统是 DSH/Codex/Multica 三宿主的跨宿主最小公分母（Codex 仅 collab 无法自定义消息协议，引入 MQ 属新增基建）；DSH 原生消息只作加速，无共享 FS 时父代理串行转发并记录降级。

nodes.label: DEC-006 新建 deep-research 技能（R0-R5 契约载体）
nodes.norm_label: dec-006 新建 deep-research 技能(r0-r5 契约载体)
nodes.rationale: 扩写 spec-research 会混淆其「后续阶段点状疑问通道」定位，只改 make-decision 一段话则无契约载体无法登记；独立技能是最干净的登记单元（职责/consumer/owner/删除条件）。

nodes.label: Phase P1 契约基础与 material_id 一致性
nodes.norm_label: phase p1 契约基础与 material_id 一致性
nodes.rationale: 先修地基：schema 增 pair_id/role/disputed 可选字段 + materialIdForInput 对齐 broker 规范算法，使后续红蓝 pair 有元数据载体且严格冻结路径不再 MATERIAL_INCOMPLETE。

nodes.label: Phase P2 红蓝双发审查（pair 校验/降级标注/争议聚合）
nodes.norm_label: phase p2 红蓝双发审查(pair 校验/降级标注/争议聚合)

nodes.label: Phase P3 争议对话闭环（写回 + 问答工具 + 合同成对更新）
nodes.norm_label: phase p3 争议对话闭环(写回 + 问答工具 + 合同成对更新)

nodes.label: Phase P4 debate v2 重写（宿主中立）
nodes.norm_label: phase p4 debate v2 重写(宿主中立)

nodes.label: Phase P5 deep-research 技能与调研条款
nodes.norm_label: phase p5 deep-research 技能与调研条款

nodes.label: Test Strategy（RED/GREEN 同 gate_cmd 同 oracle，禁止全量回归）
nodes.norm_label: test strategy(red/green 同 gate_cmd 同 oracle,禁止全量回归)

nodes.label: 关键实体 review pair（红蓝对）
nodes.norm_label: 关键实体 review pair(红蓝对)
nodes.rationale: 同 pair 必须同 material 语义身份，不满足记 partial；蓝队失败标 blue_incomplete；两次结果聚合为一个 review fact（findings 并集 + provider×角色标注）并作为 debate 输入。

nodes.label: 明确不做与默认必须成立（唯一权威非目标清单）
nodes.norm_label: 明确不做与默认必须成立(唯一权威非目标清单)
nodes.rationale: 13 条非目标/拒绝方案与 6 条默认必须成立（标准五阶段、大白话、质量事实如实、不可逆需授权、禁止自审自判、宪法红线）；本节为唯一权威列表，避免两份真相。

nodes.label: 实现计划：工作流需求收敛深度改造（plan-task.v4, 8 phase）
nodes.norm_label: 实现计划:工作流需求收敛深度改造(plan-task.v4, 8 phase)

nodes.label: 功能规格：工作流需求收敛深度改造（28 FR / 28 AC）
nodes.norm_label: 功能规格:工作流需求收敛深度改造(28 fr / 28 ac)

nodes.label: AC-06 度量改写为「已知事实清单内 0 处」+ 偏离登记
nodes.norm_label: ac-06 度量改写为「已知事实清单内 0 处」+ 偏离登记
nodes.rationale: 原 AC-06 的全局「0 处双权威声明」不可实现；改写本身是对母 PRD 的实质偏离，但不回写 PRD、只在本卡登记，须在阶段末披露并由 CARD-10 核对。

nodes.label: 适配合同缺陷：300KB 输入上限 vs 逐字全文匹配
nodes.norm_label: 适配合同缺陷:300kb 输入上限 vs 逐字全文匹配
nodes.rationale: contracts/make-decision.md 要求 approved_direction 逐字匹配 decision-log 全文并带 material revision，而 review-input-bounds.mjs 上限 307200B < 本卡 362477B → 逐字全文送入物理不可行；该上限自陈为保持 packet identity 稳定，属要彻底删除的哈希/快照机器。本次走 bare 路径，正式 run 路径未验证。

nodes.label: CARD-05（审查机制与适配合同归属）
nodes.norm_label: card-05(审查机制与适配合同归属)
nodes.rationale: card-02 只并入 CARD-05① 合并审查本体与适配合同的文档审查分档（含接口定义、不做实测）；审查能力提升的实测留 CARD-05，本卡只定 finding 有效率/锚定准确率/耗时三项判据。

nodes.label: CARD-07（make-decision 改造与扩散机制归属）
nodes.norm_label: card-07(make-decision 改造与扩散机制归属)
nodes.rationale: SD-09/SD-10 实现、make-decision SKILL 文本、K 失效条件维护与扩散常驻机制归 CARD-07；存在「定义者≠维护者」跨卡责任缝（NG-7），靠登记承接清单 + ①合并审查 checklist 兜底而非掩盖。

nodes.label: CARD-10 集成验收
nodes.rationale: 承接关系与未完成验收项的统一核对方；母 PRD 保持 final 且不回写，承接关系由 CARD-10 核对。

nodes.label: 延 CARD-10 核对项（F18/F21/F25）
nodes.rationale: 逐 REQ 单元账、可读性 rubric 正式实测、K1–K12 语义保真独立核对三项在本卡不可闭合；若强行计 fixed 即把未完成写成完成，与披露纪律冲突，故登记归属与触发条件转 CARD-10。

nodes.label: 检查器字段识别兼容修复（`- field：` 形态）
nodes.norm_label: 检查器字段识别兼容修复(`- field:` 形态)
nodes.rationale: check-decision-log-chain.mjs 的正则要求字段行首 + ASCII 冒号，而 card-01/card-02 都写 `- module：`（列表标记 + 全形冒号）导致 0/40 命中，属先于本卡存在的格式不兼容而非字段缺失；修复为 build-code 交付物，验收判据是同一检查器对全部现行 decision-log 均可识别。

nodes.label: ADR 决策块（16 行/块）
nodes.rationale: 保留 OI 大纲与三级来源追溯链（初始用户故事/需求 → R-### / 调研 → D-###）供人工上溯；偏离 R-E 的 ≤15 行因官方校验器要求 module/requirement_ids/derived_from/artifacts 四字段并兼容 card-01 既有格式。

nodes.label: SD-09 需求保真机制（双层 + 三档结论 + 强度校验）
nodes.norm_label: sd-09 需求保真机制(双层 + 三档结论 + 强度校验)
nodes.rationale: 316 单元中 38 条未完整承接的成因是缺少保真结构致压缩不可见；元机制先行否则补回的需求会被再次压缩。逐字区与指针区物理分离以避免机制变成新的刚性文档仪式。

nodes.label: 最小真实 fixture task（降为模板 smoke test）
nodes.norm_label: 最小真实 fixture task(降为模板 smoke test)
nodes.rationale: 原 AC-07/AC-08 要求抽真实 task 验收，但首个用新格式的 task 在 card-02 之后、验收时不存在；故卡内造最小真实样例，后经 F07/F19 与 T-070 降为 smoke test 并明标真实抽验未闭合。

nodes.label: 人工抽样记录验收（四类事实）
nodes.norm_label: 人工抽样记录验收(四类事实)
nodes.rationale: 轨 2 的人工抽样必须逐行给出「样本 / 权威文件 / 核对结论 / 证据」，缺任一行即判 incomplete（不判通过也不判失败）；本表不覆盖未知事实，不得推出全局零重复。

nodes.label: 稳定 ID 命名空间（U/R/RS/OI/D/FR/AC/PH + 6 形）
nodes.norm_label: 稳定 id 命名空间(u/r/rs/oi/d/fr/ac/ph + 6 形)
nodes.rationale: 定义形式（章节标题）与引用形式（指针措辞）分离，无需额外注册表（注册表本身会成为新的重复源）；F01 增补 REQ/T/V/L/X/F 六形并拆分要求 R-### 与风险 R-##。

nodes.label: 禁止「产出完整文件」型子代理任务（T-079）
nodes.norm_label: 禁止「产出完整文件」型子代理任务(t-079)
nodes.rationale: 改一次 finding 花半小时的根因是输出量而非分析慢——多次要求子代理重新生成 2800+ 行/370KB+ 全文；故大文件增量修改只产增量片段、由主会话脚本拼接（毫秒级），仅首次创建或结构性重写才允许产完整文件。

nodes.label: reconstruct→reveal→challenge 交互契约
nodes.rationale: 把方向层交互写成 step 11 可执行规则（reconstruct 不得泄漏 final_option、reveal 首次展示、challenge 逐条记录变更）以满足 F11/F23；执行者是主会话自身、记录写在既有 Talk 层，故不新增控制面、gate 或状态机。

nodes.label: L0/L1/L2 三层 phase 文档结构
nodes.norm_label: l0/l1/l2 三层 phase 文档结构
nodes.rationale: R-F 证据显示不存在「过度规格化惩罚强模型」拐点，真实代价是收益递减与任务错配；决策类任务细节收益仅 +0.02，故 L0 永不删、L1 可机检随接口钉住、L2 参考步骤可作废并带过期条件。

nodes.label: 两阶段合并账（28→13 步，净新增 0）
nodes.norm_label: 两阶段合并账(28→13 步,净新增 0)
nodes.rationale: 用户 T-036 裁定「不应纯新增，应替换合并」；合并账证明完全覆盖 10 / 部分覆盖 2 / 无承接者 0，新建最小集=空集，故本卡交付合并账而非新增清单。

nodes.label: ①合并审查（merged-review，safeReviewFacts 唯一 consumer）
nodes.rationale: R-50 警示伪合并：若给每个 lens 配独立 consumer/receipt 即为伪合并，必须只留 1 个 safeReviewFacts consumer；审查默认 advisory，只记录事实不阻断推进。

nodes.label: 无重复契约检查工具（双轨判据）
nodes.norm_label: 无重复契约检查工具(双轨判据)
nodes.rationale: 轨1 机器可检=ID 定义唯一性；轨2 人工核对+抽样=四类事实权威归属。工具真报失败但不阻断推进，符合零机器门禁与只留两道人为门；人工抽样只能作风险发现，不得作为全局零重复的证明。

nodes.label: 不设长度数值目标（九条语义判据）
nodes.norm_label: 不设长度数值目标(九条语义判据)
nodes.rationale: 用户判定长度目标「纯粹是形式主义」；改以语义判据（删后结论不变=冗余、删后行为不变=无操作、一事实一权威、禁用行号锚点与哈希 pin、术语唯一化、隐含假设显式化）为唯一手段，且不引入新机器门禁。

nodes.label: OI 状态表（17 条：resolved 16 / deferred 1）
nodes.norm_label: oi 状态表(17 条:resolved 16 / deferred 1)
nodes.rationale: F13 指出送审材料只有引用汇总而无逐条状态表；本表补齐 5 列并沿用三层生命周期（L1 开放 OI / L2 揭示的候选，reconstruct 必须隐藏 / L3 确认后绑定，下游只消费 L3）。

nodes.label: K1–K12 质量核心与承接者逐条映射
nodes.norm_label: k1–k12 质量核心与承接者逐条映射
nodes.rationale: 8→K1–K12 全部保留并逐条指派承接者；聚合计数不得替代逐条映射（F12 根因：把流程数量守恒当作质量语义守恒）。

nodes.label: 人工可读性 rubric（R1–R6）
nodes.rationale: 可读性验收不依赖字数（不设长度数值目标），改由独立来源对 fixture 的 spec/phase 实际评审；rubric 治「结构合规但仍难读、详略失当」，不通过不阻断但必须逐条可见。

nodes.label: 可失败检查 RED（含重复权威的 fixture）
nodes.norm_label: 可失败检查 red(含重复权威的 fixture)
nodes.rationale: G-2 要求补一条可失败检查或写明豁免；RED 的非零必须由目标断言导致而非 setup 失败，且由独立来源核对，以免纯文档任务的 RED 退化为形式化 RED。

nodes.label: 一事实一权威（现行权威层 vs 历史层）
nodes.norm_label: 一事实一权威(现行权威层 vs 历史层)
nodes.rationale: 用户否决审查建议的「独立当前状态投影 + 只消费 confirm 项」，判定其等于新控制面 + 新门禁；改为权威节只写现行口径 + 陈旧陈述补统一格式更正行（`> 口径更正（Fx）`）+ 历史节明确标注，零新层零 gate 零状态机。

nodes.label: spec 叙事主干 + 契约附件 A/B/C/D
nodes.norm_label: spec 叙事主干 + 契约附件 a/b/c/d
nodes.rationale: 用户否掉 10 节表单式的真实原因是组织轴错（并列容器 vs 有序论证链）；Porter 1995 显示 checklist 审阅不比 ad hoc 更有效且丢约 7% 缺陷，强格式约束伤推理（GSM8K 86.51→23.44）。失效条件：附件与主干出现同一事实两份表述即停止双读。

nodes.label: 未完成验收项登记（AC-07/AC-08 等 7 行）
nodes.norm_label: 未完成验收项登记(ac-07/ac-08 等 7 行)
nodes.rationale: 纪律：未完成即写「未完成」，本卡不得宣称 AC-07/AC-08 已满足；bare 路径结果不构成正式 run 路径会通过的证明。

nodes.label: runtime/stage 覆盖校验器粒度修复 + 接线
nodes.norm_label: runtime/stage 覆盖校验器粒度修复 + 接线
nodes.rationale: 根因是覆盖校验停在类别级且唯一逐条强校验器是无调用者的死代码，同一根因第三次复发；用户选 card-02 本卡做，须登记越 CARD-07 写面与撞车风险 R-35~R-38。

nodes.label: G-01（CRITICAL）权威层缺失 4 张收口清单 / 9 处悬空节名
nodes.norm_label: g-01(critical)权威层缺失 4 张收口清单 / 9 处悬空节名
nodes.rationale: A 类补回 / B 类排除 / 承接与不承接 / 收口自检四节只在支撑文件，材料 9 处悬空引用且 nav 谎称在「本文件末尾」→ 材料自身验收在材料内不可核对，违反本卡「文档权威与单一事实源」交付目标。

nodes.label: G-02/G-03/G-04（HIGH）定位缺失、OI 旧口径、第四态冲突
nodes.norm_label: g-02/g-03/g-04(high)定位缺失、oi 旧口径、第四态冲突

nodes.norm_label: 逻辑属性替代表与 rtl 镜像纪律

nodes.label: 共享五列 review 输出契约（Severity/Location/Before/After/Why + Verification + Verdict）
nodes.norm_label: 共享五列 review 输出契约(severity/location/before/after/why + verification + verdict)
nodes.rationale: better-colors / better-layout / better-typography / better-ui / better-accessibility 的 review-output 结构完全同构（同一五列表、同一 Severity 与 Block/Needs changes/Approve 词汇表），应提取为单一契约 + 各领域 Severity 定义补丁，而不是复制多份拷贝；被 better-interface 编排时格式/严重度/合并/上限/裁决归上层。

nodes.label: 角色化字阶（每阶绑定 size + line-height + weight）
nodes.norm_label: 角色化字阶(每阶绑定 size + line-height + weight)
nodes.rationale: 一个角色一次决策而非三次（产品界面起点：Display 36/1.1/600 … Caption 13/1.4/400）；按用途命名而非按尺寸，与 better-colors 的 semantic token 层同构；配「用项目自己的惯用法写修复」把统一性延伸为不引入第二套样式体系。

nodes.label: Better UI 16 条数值处方（同心圆角 / 阴影代边框 / 可中断动画 / scale 0.96 / 图标描边-字重映射）
nodes.norm_label: better ui 16 条数值处方(同心圆角 / 阴影代边框 / 可中断动画 / scale 0.96 / 图标描边-字重映射)
nodes.rationale: 把嵌套半径（outer = inner + padding）、图标描边与文字字重映射等从感觉变成可算规则，且多数可机器检查（transition-all 禁令、will-change 白名单、currentColor 单 SVG 按态变色、scale 不得低于 0.95）；零脚本零依赖，是 P0 中移植成本最低的一个，另带一套 10% 速度回放评审方法。

nodes.norm_label: impeccable 有界验证(一轮批式检查 + 最多一次确认轮,两轮上限)
nodes.rationale: build fully → 一次批式检查（web 上 desktop+mobile 同轮）→ 一批修完 → 最多再一轮确认 → 停止打磨；开放式 self-QA 被明确定性为烧钱行为，为 workflowhub 的 QA 迭代设上限协议。

nodes.label: Impeccable Craft Floor（Verify 9 条 + Refuse 20 条质量地板）
nodes.norm_label: impeccable craft floor(verify 9 条 + refuse 20 条质量地板)
nodes.rationale: 编辑 UI 前必载的绝对禁令：对比度 4.5:1/3:1、行长 65–75ch、display ≤6rem、字距下限 -0.04em、禁嵌套卡片、禁 kicker（唯一无 brief 可挣回项）、elevation 只声明一次。地板只管机械不管方向 — 全绿后把页面花在承诺的世界上，纠结时 commit。

nodes.label: detect.mjs 确定性反模式检测器（约 58 条注册规则，exit 0=clean / 2=有发现）
nodes.norm_label: detect.mjs 确定性反模式检测器(约 58 条注册规则,exit 0=clean / 2=有发现)
nodes.rationale: 规则覆盖 AI 审美聚集色板、字体黑名单、kicker/编号标签、嵌套卡片与 design-system-* 漂移检测；定位是缺陷证据而非质量证明（须逐条在上下文中核实、标出误报），机械事实可采集但不构成推进许可证。

nodes.label: Impeccable 双独立子代理评审（A 设计评审 / B 检测器证据）+ Nielsen 0–4 打分
nodes.norm_label: impeccable 双独立子代理评审(a 设计评审 / b 检测器证据)+ nielsen 0–4 打分
nodes.rationale: A 与 B 必须作为两个隔离子代理并行，且 A 先完成、detector 发现才进父合成上下文以防锚定；inline 单上下文运行即降级，报告首行必须挂 ⚠️ DEGRADED 横幅 — 沉默降级=失败评审。这条直接呼应 workflowhub 宪法「质量裁决由独立来源在独立上下文产出，禁止自审自判」与「provider 失败不得改写为质量通过」。

nodes.label: 删除侧信号路由表（- 侧线索 → owner 技能，含等价替换白名单）
nodes.norm_label: 删除侧信号路由表(- 侧线索 → owner 技能,含等价替换白名单)
nodes.rationale: 信号是线索不是发现：删除只有在变更中无替代时才是回归，判断归领域技能；路由前先查等价替换清单（aria-label→labelledby、outline→box-shadow 焦点环、物理属性→逻辑属性、字符串移入翻译目录），否则报告会装满实为重构的「回归」。

nodes.label: 变更范围解析与爆炸半径扩展（merge-base 优先 / 一跳两跳 / 最多 5 个消费者）
nodes.norm_label: 变更范围解析与爆炸半径扩展(merge-base 优先 / 一跳两跳 / 最多 5 个消费者)
nodes.rationale: 解析顺序是硬规则：先查工作区会让一个游荡的格式化编辑遮蔽 12 个 commit 的分支；无变更时禁止自行退回 HEAD~1..HEAD（最后 commit 常是 merge 或别人的工作）而应陈述事实并给三条路线。无界扫描产出无法支撑的覆盖声明，故须声明未扩展的消费者数量。

nodes.label: 三态发现分类（Introduced / Regression / Pre-existing）
nodes.norm_label: 三态发现分类(introduced / regression / pre-existing)
nodes.rationale: 按 diff 触及的行而非所在文件分类（未触及的行即使离 hunk 三行也是 Pre-existing，必要时 git blame 对 base ref 确认），使「本次变更引入的债」与历史债分离、Pre-existing 不背锅；回归在变更后状态中不可见，所以必须读 diff 的 - 侧。

nodes.label: 禁止布尔 prop 泛滥与 renderX props（改用显式变体组件）
nodes.norm_label: 禁止布尔 prop 泛滥与 renderx props(改用显式变体组件)
nodes.rationale: 每个布尔 prop 使可能状态数翻倍并产生不可维护的条件逻辑，读调用点也看不出实际渲染什么；显式变体（ThreadComposer/EditMessageComposer/ForwardMessageComposer）消灭不可能状态并自文档化，判据一句话：组合静态结构用 children，需要回传数据才用 render props。

nodes.label: 复合组件三段式 context 接口（state / actions / meta）与 provider 依赖注入
nodes.norm_label: 复合组件三段式 context 接口(state / actions / meta)与 provider 依赖注入
nodes.rationale: 组合优于配置：接口是契约，任何 provider 实现它、同一套 UI 即可配完全不同状态实现 —「Swap the provider, keep the UI」；关键判据是 provider 边界（而非视觉嵌套）才是有效边界，因此状态提升后 Frame 外的兄弟组件照样可读写 state/actions，同时消除 prop drilling、useEffect 向上同步与 ref 读状态三类反模式。

nodes.label: 重渲染与渲染性能规则（rerender- 15 条 / rendering- 11 条 / js- 14 条）
nodes.norm_label: 重渲染与渲染性能规则(rerender- 15 条 / rendering- 11 条 / js- 14 条)
nodes.rationale: 覆盖组件边界（禁内联组件防 remount、静态 JSX 外提、memo 边界）与渲染主线程（content-visibility 约 10×、js-index-maps 1M→2K ops）；frontmatter 的 impact 分级本身就是筛选机制，所以正确用法是保留全量 70 条 + 索引按需读取，物理裁剪会制造第二份被裁剪的真相、违反 ADR 不复制外部规则的精神。

nodes.label: 消除瀑布流与包体积优化（async- / bundle- 两类 CRITICAL 规则）
nodes.norm_label: 消除瀑布流与包体积优化(async- / bundle- 两类 critical 规则)
nodes.rationale: 瀑布流是性能第一杀手，每个串行 await 都付整次网络延迟；barrel 导入光导入即 200–800ms、Monaco 类大组件约 300KB。CRITICAL 级收益集中在数据密集前端，规则以「判据 + 正误对照 + impact 分级」形态供生成/评审/重构逐条引用。

nodes.label: Web Interface Guidelines 103 条远端规则快照（17 大类 + 14 条反模式）
nodes.norm_label: web interface guidelines 103 条远端规则快照(17 大类 + 14 条反模式)
nodes.rationale: 技能本体仅 40 行且不含任何规则，规则 100% 在远端 main 分支运行时抓取 — 离线或被墙即失效、审查标准随上游实时漂移，故集成必须固化快照（含 file:line / ✓ pass / 按文件分组 的输出格式约定）并记录抓取日期与 diff 同步流程。

nodes.label: ADR 0016 external-first 前端组件质量（唯一调用者 Build-plan/Build-code/Verify-code）
nodes.norm_label: adr 0016 external-first 前端组件质量(唯一调用者 build-plan/build-code/verify-code)
nodes.rationale: ADR 要求完整放入 skills/external/vercel-react-best-practices/ 并保留 LICENSE/UPSTREAM、不复制外部规则进薄适配；深读发现现仓只有 21 行手写摘要占位、skills/external/ 不存在，即 ADR 尚未执行 — 保留全量按需索引，不做 HIGH+ 子集裁剪。

nodes.norm_label: eliminate external stage agent task plan

nodes.label: Per-OI No-gap Protocol Conflict
nodes.rationale: The provider protocol carries findings but not per-OI checked_no_gap proof, so the phase records the conflict rather than inventing evidence.

nodes.label: Build-spec Before Build-plan
nodes.rationale: Build-plan depends on spec.md, so the two stages must run in order rather than bypassing the explicit precondition.

nodes.label: Main Session as Sole Formal Producer
nodes.norm_label: main session as sole formal producer
nodes.rationale: The current WorkflowHub session directly executes and publishes stage facts; an external Stage Agent or bridge is only optional historical compatibility.

nodes.label: Quality Facts Are Not Permission
nodes.rationale: Review, test, evidence, history, and stage outcomes record facts; they do not become a work-authorization gate.

nodes.label: Entry, Testing, and Acceptance Are Distinct
nodes.norm_label: entry, testing, and acceptance are distinct
nodes.rationale: An entry can exist, tests can be collected, and business acceptance can pass; these are separate facts and must not be conflated.

nodes.label: Executable Acceptance and Oracle Governance
nodes.rationale: Acceptance needs observable behavior, measurable success, failure cases, and an independently fixed oracle with provenance; missing evidence stays incomplete.

nodes.label: acceptance evidence result semantics
nodes.rationale: Preserve inconclusive and deferred as unproven quality facts while counting only fail as failed evidence, preventing semantic compression and pointless retries.

nodes.label: no automatic retry on inconclusive evidence
nodes.norm_label: no automatic retry on inconclusive evidence
nodes.rationale: Evidence insufficiency and deferred human or A/B work must remain visible rather than trigger repeated review and testing until an artificial pass appears.

nodes.label: ordinary close strict quality predicate
nodes.rationale: Keep ordinary close limited to passed quality facts; inconclusive and deferred remain incomplete even though they no longer masquerade as implementation failures.

nodes.label: three separated predicates
nodes.rationale: Separate permission to continue work, authenticity of formal writes, and ability to claim completion so audit gaps remain visible without becoming a development gate.

nodes.label: 设计宪法约束（21 条可追溯、无第二完成权威）
nodes.norm_label: 设计宪法约束(21 条可追溯、无第二完成权威)

nodes.norm_label: deferred/inconclusive 语义(永不压成 pass,保持 incomplete)

nodes.norm_label: make-decision direction a→b 无状态两段审查(单条 review fact)

nodes.label: tests/contract/acceptance-execution-producer.mjs（T006 拥有的 canonical report producer）
nodes.rationale: 契约刻意窄：接收冻结输入（package-local Vitest argv + AC 映射），以无 shell 语义执行一次，解析机器报告并只返回 {entries}；不读 task store、不选 latest、不读环境变量、不伪造手工证据。owner=T006，唯一 consumer 是既有 private service launcher，删除条件是出现经审查的等价 producer。

nodes.label: runtime/evidence/host-session-transcript.mjs（保留的薄适配器）
nodes.rationale: 只拥有 descriptor/path 解析、事件投影与注册来源构造，全部压缩字节解码委托给既有 decompressZstdFrames/readDshTranscriptText；禁止复制 magic 常量、块解析器、帧切分或 catch-and-skip 解码器。

nodes.label: D-001 问题定性：不是缺大纲，而是大纲没有闭环
nodes.norm_label: d-001 问题定性:不是缺大纲,而是大纲没有闭环
nodes.rationale: 根因不是用户没说清楚，而是「大纲的消费者、关闭规则与判据」缺失；被拒方案是把根因归给用户。代价是改造面比只改文本大，需要动 runtime。

nodes.label: D-004 三个消费者与各自职责
nodes.norm_label: d-004 三个消费者与各自职责
nodes.rationale: 方向审查核对完整性、细节审查逐条对账是否真收敛、用户按主题分组处置未收敛项；职责不可互相替代，避免靠主会话自述宣布收敛。

nodes.label: D-005 方向审查材料新增必需字段 convergence_outline
nodes.norm_label: d-005 方向审查材料新增必需字段 convergence_outline
nodes.rationale: 修正审查意见 F-9926853a51ab/F-443ec071b402：字段若为可选就无法强制核对，因此把 convergence_outline 加入 required，内容为 questions-only 快照。风险：新字段尚未实测（RISK-01）。

nodes.label: D-008 未收敛项按主题分组确认
nodes.norm_label: d-008 未收敛项按主题分组确认
nodes.rationale: 修正 G-2 的「统一批量确认」：影响目标/范围/验收的项必须单独成组逐项列出，每组附独立性依据。风险是主会话可能把关键项塞进不显眼的组，由细节审查受控反例抽查。

nodes.label: D-016 「命名未知」的最低写法（四件）
nodes.norm_label: d-016 「命名未知」的最低写法(四件)
nodes.rationale: 合法未知必须写清不知道什么＋类别＋来源＋为什么现在不知道；缺任一项保持 open。Supersedes OPEN-02（原「留给 build-spec」），把核心规则收回本阶段。

nodes.label: D-020 outline_closed 的五项合取 oracle
nodes.norm_label: d-020 outline_closed 的五项合取 oracle
nodes.rationale: outline_closed=passed 当且仅当五项同时成立：OI 清单与六类结构齐备、方向审查含当前版本 questions-only 快照、无未处置 open、终态字段完整、核心条目带可核验用户处置凭证；任一不成立即 missing，但不阻断同任务修复。

nodes.label: D-021 终态字段表（唯一权威）
nodes.norm_label: d-021 终态字段表(唯一权威)
nodes.rationale: 以字段表替代「四要素/四件套」这类计数称呼，避免术语漂移导致验收与实现错位；open/confirmed/deferred/not_applicable 各有唯一必填字段与可转出者。

nodes.label: D-029 选项 B：WorkflowHub 侧补齐宿主需求源
nodes.norm_label: d-029 选项 b:workflowhub 侧补齐宿主需求源
nodes.rationale: stage_end_spec_analyze 缺认证需求投影，用户选择 WorkflowHub 侧补齐：显式 opt-in + 机械规则提取真实用户消息 + 复用既有 source reader。必须写明属性下降——冻结列表与内容同源于同一文件同一进程，不再是独立启动器锚；失败一律 unavailable 且不伪造；宿主原生实现落地后删除适配。

nodes.label: DEC-001 Host-neutral thin adapter（kind: host-session）
nodes.rationale: 保留 D-029 的 opt-in/机械筛选/诚实限制，只取代其中陈旧的 DSH 专属工程措辞；真实威胁是损坏多帧输入被部分接受，任何调用方 selector、latest 扫描、重复解码器或跳过坏帧兜底都会绕过机械完整性。

nodes.label: DEC-002 One close subject（唯一 outline_closed）
nodes.norm_label: dec-002 one close subject(唯一 outline_closed)
nodes.rationale: 在既有 parser/handler/predicate 链上只扩展一个 outline_closed 主体并附原子替换证明，不引入第二权威。

nodes.label: ORACLE-EVIDENCE（有界证据索引，不伪造手工事实）
nodes.norm_label: oracle-evidence(有界证据索引,不伪造手工事实)
nodes.rationale: T007 只准备验收请求与证据引用：固定夹具审查、历史样本独立打分、dispatch/workflow/governance 精确文件普查、引用真实交互 ref+sha256；能力证明 unavailable 保持 unavailable，不得改写成 pass。

nodes.label: ORACLE-FINAL（既有验收路线 + 精确 21 AC 集合）
nodes.norm_label: oracle-final(既有验收路线 + 精确 21 ac 集合)
nodes.rationale: 外层复用既有 build-code 验收聚合命令，内层复用既有 private service tier；精确 21 个 AC 各出现一次，重试必须改变请求字节与 SHA-256，同 hash 重试被拒绝，失败尝试与原始流不可改写。

nodes.label: ORACLE-OI-CONTRACT（框架节点 + 固定六类 + 分组字段）
nodes.norm_label: oracle-oi-contract(框架节点 + 固定六类 + 分组字段)
nodes.rationale: 六个功能框架节点与六个固定类别都必须含至少一个 OI 引用或显式有理由的空条目；遗漏、裸「无」、重复权威或类别替换即失败；版本不匹配、摘要式输出、答案泄漏或核心 OI 被降级为 ordinary_detail 不能满足消费者。

nodes.label: ORACLE-OUTLINE-CLOSED（baseline / subtraction / stale proof）
nodes.rationale: 以五项减法、stale/迟到夹具和占位反例证明任一合取项缺失即 missing；同一 oracle 也用于替换等价性比较（五字段等价矩阵），任何字段不等或 oracle 结果不同即停止替换。

nodes.label: ORACLE-SOURCE（桥接子进程 + 严格 zstd 矩阵）
nodes.norm_label: oracle-source(桥接子进程 + 严格 zstd 矩阵)
nodes.rationale: 覆盖合法拼接帧、可跳过帧、截断帧头/块头/载荷、保留块类型、压缩载荷内伪造 magic、校验和不匹配与尾随垃圾；每个非法用例的整体 oracle 都是来源 unavailable 且需求消息数为 0。

nodes.label: Phase P1 — 宿主需求源窄适配
nodes.norm_label: phase p1 — 宿主需求源窄适配
nodes.rationale: 显式 host-session 来源经既有认证链产出当前消息；任何 zstd 异常整体 unavailable/零消息。STOP：selector、latest 扫描、重复解码器、fallback、新 store/schema/public command 或破坏 main 已有 coordination 校验。

nodes.label: ADR 0012 Current Materials Derived Publication
nodes.rationale: The decision is hard to reverse, future readers would otherwise wonder why historical mechanisms no longer participate in current runs, and it is a genuine trade-off between auditable history and low complexity - all three ADR conditions hold. The ADR supersedes ADR 0005/0008/0009/0011 and the relevant parts of ADR 0007/0002 while keeping deterministic identity, historical bytes, independent review and severe-finding handling.

nodes.label: Four Current Materials Are the Working Truth
nodes.norm_label: four current materials are the working truth
nodes.rationale: Multiple current selectors (requirements pointer, accepted checkpoint, reopen/rebind/recovery/reset) conflict; reusing the single existing task-material-revision.v1 and leaving history read-only keeps one current state while preserving old bytes and hashes for audit.

nodes.label: Per-Deletion Proof Card and Vertical Slices
nodes.norm_label: per-deletion proof card and vertical slices
nodes.rationale: Deletion risk cannot be judged from file names, so each candidate proves consumer/reverse references, preserved quality semantics, replacement path, the same negative oracle before and after, fault injection, Multica compatibility and a rollback commit. Missing any item means KEEP. The proof card stays an ordinary build-plan/build-code task field - it must never become a new state machine.

nodes.label: Direction Review Finding F-6bf98330c313
nodes.rationale: The direction review verdict revise_required is preserved unchanged; the finding showed the original plan demanded per-item proof without defining a single recomputable deletion proof, so the repair added the proof card, vertical deletion slices, negative oracle, fault injection, Multica compatibility and rollback requirements.

nodes.label: Full File Inventory and Stable AGENTS.md Rules
nodes.norm_label: full file inventory and stable agents.md rules
nodes.rationale: A full tracked-file inventory (KEEP/MOVE/MERGE/DELETE/GENERATE/ARCHIVE) surfaces orphans, while AGENTS.md records only stable directory responsibilities and dependency direction so the rules do not drift the way a per-file list would.

nodes.label: Quality Facts Append-Only, Publication Derived
nodes.rationale: Review, test, confirmation and authorization facts are worth keeping as original bytes, but turning them into work permits let old heads lock business tasks. Publication recomputes from current materials and facts once, satisfying both append-only audit and normal revision; completion predicates must stay few, direct and failable so derived logic cannot silently pass.

nodes.label: Tests Converge to Quality Predicates and Fault Injection
nodes.norm_label: tests converge to quality predicates and fault injection
nodes.rationale: Deleting the state machines removes their combination space, so tests are designed against external quality predicates instead: five-stage E2E, material revision, severe findings, canonical write failure, legacy read-only/import and Skill Bundle clean-install. Every test deletion must be bound to a deleted capability and a replacement oracle, because a wrongly deleted unique oracle is the main risk.

nodes.label: Multica Skill Bundle vs Local Runner Release
nodes.norm_label: multica skill bundle vs local runner release
nodes.rationale: Multica only consumes stages and skills, so it needs the minimal runnable skill package; tests, history migration and dependency install belong to the Runner repo. node_modules is not committed and not bundled - only the lockfile installs it locally or in CI - which shrinks the Multica install surface without sacrificing local formal verification.

nodes.label: Clean-Install Read-Only Runner Verification
nodes.rationale: Business tasks run through a clean-install read-only Runner in a Mutica-like empty directory, and tracked plus untracked content hashes of the WorkflowHub source tree must be identical before and after, proving the Hub is never modified to work around the Hub.

nodes.label: DEC-003 Delete and Move Separation
nodes.rationale: Tidy directories can mask mechanisms that still exist, so vertical deletion happens in Phase 5 and mechanical directory movement only in Phase 8; each behaviour change stays independently provable and revertible, and a KEEP slice does not block other proven slices.

nodes.label: DeletionProof Contract
nodes.rationale: Fields are consumer, quality_semantic, replacement, before_after_oracle, fault_injection, Multica, legacy, rollback and user_decision, held as ordinary plan/evidence fields with no lifecycle state, so the proof itself cannot regrow into a state machine.

nodes.label: Twelve Vertical Deletion Slices DEL-01..DEL-12
nodes.rationale: Each slice runs RED (prove the old entry is still reachable) then GREEN (delete grill replacement, phase trace lineage, dedicated invalidation, continuation, rebind, reopen, stage recovery, recovery/reset workspace CAS, duplicate projection, transition journal, shadow checkpoints, obsolete tools). A slice whose proof is incomplete or still has consumers is explicitly KEEP - KEEP is not failure and deleting to hit a count is forbidden; every GREEN keeps its own diff, evidence and revert boundary.

nodes.label: Two Human Gates T021 and T056
nodes.norm_label: two human gates t021 and t056
nodes.rationale: T021 confirms the planned deletion list before any irreversible removal and T056 confirms the actual deletions and diff at the end; commit, push, close and worktree deletion remain separately authorized, so plan confirmation can never be read as Git permission.

nodes.label: LegacyImport Model
nodes.rationale: Accepts only the spec FR-LEG-001 minimal format (source schema/hash, task identity, four materials, requirements, original facts) and rejects unknown, conflicting, corrupt or dual-write-demanding shapes; identical input yields identical identity.

nodes.label: MaterialRevision Data Model
nodes.rationale: The single current revision of the four materials plus requirements ledger/coverage records parent_ref/hash, the four material refs and hashes, changed files and source, and is create-only with CAS. It must not decide tests, review or formal completion.

nodes.label: Per-File Inventory and Deletion Plan Tools
nodes.norm_label: per-file inventory and deletion plan tools
nodes.rationale: Phase 0 generates a recomputable inventory, complexity baseline and deletion-proof contract before any production capability is removed; every tracked file must land in exactly one disposition and the 12 candidates must carry a proof status, with baseline numbers recomputed from the current tree rather than inherited from the downloaded plan.

nodes.label: Requirement and Verification Traceability Matrix
nodes.rationale: Every FR maps to task IDs, AC IDs, phases and an owning gate/evidence, and the original dictated requirements plus the downloaded plan are audited so each item lands in spec, phase, task and an executable gate; the audit concludes that the downloaded plan's historical 30-day/one-release compatibility window is explicitly overridden by later dictation - no compatibility period, and unsafe handling is a STOP.

nodes.label: Seven-Behavior Public Runtime Facade
nodes.rationale: CLI stable behaviors are fixed at doctor/status/run/review/verify/confirm/authorize, shrinking the public cognitive surface while reusing TaskHandle and wh-review. The risk is a long-lived dual-track wrapper, so Phase 5 must delete the old entry points.

nodes.label: Test Strategy: 3 E2E, 5 Mutations, Writer Fault Matrix
nodes.norm_label: test strategy: 3 e2e, 5 mutations, writer fault matrix
nodes.rationale: Three synthetic E2E scenarios (normal execution with unchanged Hub source, mid-task material revision plus severe-finding repair, idempotent resume after write interruption or unavailable review) plus five deliberate breakage samples (identity/tree/hash misbinding, missing completion, review unavailable or severe finding, confirmation-vs-authorization confusion, Bundle closure pollution) must all go red when the protection is broken. Behaviors are RED=1 on the behavior gate, paired GREEN=0, non-behavior gates=0, and mechanisms are deleted before their dedicated tests.

nodes.label: Final Three-Provider Architecture Review
nodes.rationale: Phase 9 runs clean install, the full quality matrix and a formal three-party architecture review through the official wh-review seam with providers fixed at kimi/k3, claude-code/opus and cursor/grok; if no aggregate semantic verdict forms, the canonical unavailable attempt and its diagnosis stay as audit facts and the verify summary states incomplete - never pass, never a fallback bridge, and historical provider trees are never work permits.

nodes.label: TaskHandle Atomic Writers and Writer Cutover
nodes.norm_label: taskhandle atomic writers and writer cutover
nodes.rationale: TaskHandle keeps nofollow/create-only/CAS safety semantics; the cutover to the single new writer must be atomic, with the old writer remaining the only production writer until the full fault matrix (temp write, fsync, rename, CAS, current pointer) and concurrent single-winner idempotency are proven. If unprovable, the task STOPS rather than adding a sixth persistent object family.

nodes.label: Acceptance Criteria AC-01..AC-15
nodes.rationale: Each AC names its requirements, verification method, pass condition, failure condition and evidence type, so acceptance is machine-checkable; AC-06 and AC-07 bind deletion proof, AC-08 binds legacy zeroing, AC-10/AC-11 bind distribution compatibility and AC-12/AC-14 bind anti-fragile test and non-blocking complexity reporting.

nodes.label: Non-Blocking Complexity Budget FR-MET-001
nodes.rationale: Build and verify produce one recomputable static complexity report without adding a runtime metrics system: test lines 12k warning, focused tests 15s cap, full tests 120s cap, public Runner behaviors cap 8, schemas cap 10, persistent object families cap 5, single core file cap 1000 lines, production code cap 15k lines. Overshoot is reported with actual/target/delta and hot spots and never alone fails the delivery, while recovery-state zero, dual-write zero and Bundle-forbidden-content zero stay hard gates.

nodes.label: Derived Formal Publication from Current Facts
nodes.norm_label: derived formal publication from current facts
nodes.rationale: Continuing to work, having a structurally valid result and being good enough to complete are three independent judgements. File existence, a successful command, a provider exit or an old accepted record can never alone constitute completion, and any identity/hash/task/stage/tree/capability mismatch fails immediately rather than partially writing.

nodes.label: Skill Bundle and Runner Release Distribution
nodes.norm_label: skill bundle and runner release distribution
nodes.rationale: Skill Bundle is Multica's lightweight consumable and must exclude tests, dependency install directories, historical material, task evidence and host absolute paths; Runner Release independently declares its compatible interface so that a missing or incompatible Runner permits explanation and drafting but forbids formal records or claiming verify/close success.

nodes.label: Evidence-Driven Vertical Deletion
nodes.rationale: Deletion is premised on equivalent quality semantics, not on falling file or line counts; the zeroing list (dedicated recovery/reopen/rebind/continuation commands, stage-transition authority state, accepted checkpoint edit permits, stage recovery run/source, Grill replacement, phase trace lineage, duplicate fact projections and dual writers) must all reach 0, and no slice may commit without close authorization.

nodes.label: Legacy Task Import Proof and Immediate Exit
nodes.norm_label: legacy task import proof and immediate exit
nodes.rationale: Only a task-local offline importer is allowed; after frozen fixtures prove no content loss and idempotent repeat import, the reader/importer/schema/fixture are deleted inside the same task so legacy compatibility in final source, release package and public entry points is exactly 0. Dual-writing old and new formats is forbidden and any failed migration proof is a STOP.

nodes.label: Unified Current Material Revision
nodes.rationale: Four current materials plus the current code tree and one material revision are the basis for continued work; the requirements ledger and coverage bind to the same revision and lose their independent current pointers, so historical results can never act as a work permit while history stays read-only.

nodes.label: Multica Clean Install Scenario SCN-008
nodes.rationale: Given only a Skill Bundle and a declared-compatible Runner Release, installing into a clean target must resolve the Stage, Skill and review dependency closure completely; the Bundle contains no tests, dependency install directories, historical tasks or host absolute paths, and a missing compatible Runner forbids writing formal results.

nodes.label: Runner Contract Version Fields and Match Rule
nodes.norm_label: runner contract version fields and match rule
nodes.rationale: Bundle declares runner_contract_major (positive integer) and runner_contract_min_minor (nonnegative integer); Runner declares runner_contract_major and runner_contract_minor; major must be equal and the Runner minor must be at least the Bundle minimum, with missing fields, wrong types or mismatches all failing loud.

nodes.rationale: Clarification preserves locked decisions, keeps upstream unresolved items visible, and asks only about newly material ambiguity.

nodes.label: Independent-axis question batch
nodes.rationale: Independent decision axes are batched, while dependent axes wait for a real answer; each question has mutually exclusive consequences and risks.

nodes.label: Global spec implementation design
nodes.rationale: Post-cohort spec.md owns the global product contract and implementation design, while each Phase owns only its independently deliverable delta.

nodes.label: Frozen RED/GREEN test contract
nodes.rationale: Behavior changes require a real target RED, a paired GREEN using the same oracle, preserved evidence, and honest coverage limits.

nodes.label: Two-step PRD authoring

nodes.label: Appendix A acceptance authority
nodes.rationale: Appendix A is the exclusive authority for acceptance conditions, measurable pass criteria, failures, and expected evidence.

nodes.label: WR001 agent-document writing rules
nodes.rationale: The sole writing specification preserves conditions and failure strength while minimizing duplication, sediment, no-op prose, and premature completion claims.

nodes.label: Human-readable stage handoff
nodes.rationale: A handoff is a derived, copyable view for people and downstream sessions; it is not a quality verdict, work permit, or material substitute.

nodes.label: Evidence-backed reflection candidates
nodes.rationale: Optional reflection records observed process facts and offers sourced candidates without becoming a quality score, release decision, or continuation gate.

nodes.label: Dynamic question queue
nodes.rationale: Talk ranks real unresolved questions by directional impact, batches only independent axes, and changes the queue only when facts or real answers change it.

nodes.label: Risk-dimension testing blueprint
nodes.rationale: The blueprint names applicable risk dimensions, scenarios, oracles, fixtures, evidence, and coverage limits without becoming a test-pass gate.

nodes.label: ZHI-65 跨 stage 产物断链根因
nodes.norm_label: zhi-65 跨 stage 产物断链根因
nodes.rationale: Multica 临时 workdir 生命周期与 agent run 绑定，run 结束即清理；make-decision 写入的 decision-log 在后续 stage checkout 时读不到。故 task worktree 必须建在沙箱生命周期之外的固定路径，且两者不能是同一目录。

nodes.label: 3rd-review 前移至 merge 之前（修正 decision-log D5 顺序）
nodes.norm_label: 3rd-review 前移至 merge 之前(修正 decision-log d5 顺序)
nodes.rationale: D5 原顺序先 merge 再审：若 revise_required，代码已进 main 只能 forward-fix，回滚代价极高。先审后 merge 消除不可逆动作在未过审前发生的高风险场景。

nodes.label: Commit and close traceability gaps
nodes.rationale: Hard commit requirements, close review gates, artifact ordering, and forbidden-file checks must be executable rather than advisory or producer-order blind.

nodes.label: Task-tracking-root normalization contract
nodes.rationale: A single canonical normalization rule is needed so YAML and environment sources resolve to the same task-tracking root.

nodes.label: Fail-closed independent review
nodes.rationale: Irreversible merge, push, and deletion require an executed independent review verdict; unavailable or not-executed review cannot be treated as success.

nodes.label: No-change record contract
nodes.rationale: Stages with no file changes should record a no-change reason in stage-result or journal instead of creating empty marker commits.

nodes.label: Task-id normalization
nodes.rationale: Normalize human task names before validation so approved names map deterministically to branch identifiers.

nodes.label: Proxy evidence distinction
nodes.rationale: Only verify-code has direct collected data; the other four metrics are explicitly marked as proxy-derived, so the baseline is not presented as uniformly direct evidence.

nodes.label: Fixed baseline snapshot
nodes.rationale: A fixed, non-rolling snapshot prevents the comparison baseline from drifting while the bridge is being used.

nodes.label: Unknown metric honesty
nodes.rationale: When the collector cannot support a metric or methods differ, the report records unknown or approximate values instead of manufacturing a green result.

nodes.label: Archive reading boundary
nodes.rationale: Archived material preserves provenance and incomplete facts but is not itself a claim that product capability was implemented or accepted.

nodes.label: Confirm and authorize human gates
nodes.rationale: The protocol separates confirmation of reviewable answers from authorization of irreversible Git operations, so execution does not silently cross a human boundary.

nodes.label: Trusted base derivation
nodes.rationale: The rebind baseline must derive from committed integration HEAD plus the accepted spec blob rather than an arbitrary live workspace tree.

nodes.label: Task-id-derived artifact path
nodes.rationale: An explicit task-id is simpler and safer than inferring feature identity from a Git branch; missing identity fails loudly rather than falling back.

nodes.label: Non-blocking constitution check
nodes.rationale: Constitution findings are surfaced as a complete 21-item record; nonconforming items do not block stage progress, while missing or incomplete output remains falsifiable failure.

nodes.label: ambiguity-ledger.v1 spec 重大歧义账本
nodes.norm_label: ambiguity-ledger.v1 spec 重大歧义账本
nodes.rationale: 每条重大歧义只能结束为用户决定、由锁定决定唯一推导的 spec-local fact 或明确 blocker；能独立变化的行为必须拆成独立轴，未清 blocker 阻止 build-spec 发布。

nodes.label: audit-aggregator：唯一过程完成权威
nodes.rationale: 扩展既有 audit-aggregator 而不是新建 completion engine：新建 verdict 会造成双头权威，违反单一权威约束。缺失/重复/乱序/篡改/错绑必须 fail-loud，不得降级为 warning。

nodes.label: 31 个 bootstrap runtime 路径原样回放
nodes.norm_label: 31 个 bootstrap runtime 路径原样回放
nodes.rationale: tar + manifest 是唯一恢复权威，patch 仅用于审计；31/31 SHA-256 必须逐字节一致，差异不能人工重写，也不能重建第二套实现。

nodes.label: CONSTITUTION 1.3.0（F3/F4/F7/Q1/Q2 修订，仍 21 条）
nodes.rationale: 严重 review 暂停不得在宪法修改前实现：先升级 1.3.0、同步 checklist/修订来源/旧新映射并完成独立宪法审查，才允许 RSK 实现 diff。区分结构事实、一般质量事实与已确认阈值的严重 finding。

nodes.label: append-only continuation 与 legacy 只读兼容
nodes.norm_label: append-only continuation 与 legacy 只读兼容
nodes.rationale: 旧记录只读、不追溯判假、不自动 backfill；继续工作必须创建隔离的新 revision 并 append-only 绑定旧 accepted/attempt ref/hash 与原因，previous_result_ref 不负责创建新 flow。

nodes.label: D1–D7 字面量更正 appendix (decision-correction-appendix.v1)
nodes.rationale: 旧 accepted decision-log 的 D1–D7 不允许原地改写，只能 append-only 补七条固定更正并保存原 ref/hash 与 does_not_rewrite_upstream=true。

nodes.label: decision-coverage-audit.v1 最终确认前逐条覆盖审计
nodes.norm_label: decision-coverage-audit.v1 最终确认前逐条覆盖审计
nodes.rationale: 必须在最终确认卡前生成；未映射且未明确接受的遗漏阻止确认，coverage status 保持 accepted_omission 而不伪造 covered。

nodes.label: decision-entry.v1 唯一决定条目 schema
nodes.norm_label: decision-entry.v1 唯一决定条目 schema
nodes.rationale: 正文与 omission appendix 共用一个 schema，避免两处维护决定字段副本；必须同时保留 source_type、exact excerpt、approval binding 和人类可读含义/后果/风险。

nodes.label: decision-log-contract.v1 恰好一次覆盖
nodes.rationale: accepted_decision_coverage 必须枚举每条来源并证明恰好覆盖一次：零次是遗漏、两次是重复，均失败。

nodes.label: 独立人类可读 decision-log.md + receipt ref/hash
nodes.norm_label: 独立人类可读 decision-log.md + receipt ref/hash
nodes.rationale: 选择 Markdown 主文件 + receipt 只存 ref/hash 合同事实，而非 receipt 内单字符串摘要：多一个 artifact，换来人工可读性与稳定 diff，同时下游只经 accepted decision_ref 读取最终版本。

nodes.label: decision-omission-acceptance.v1 专用遗漏接受
nodes.rationale: 与 review 的 risk-acceptance 分成两个 schema：两种风险对象与放行边界不同，混用会错误放行遗漏或结构错误。

nodes.label: 宿主独立性（无 Multica / Issue 身份 / cwd / root 注入）
nodes.norm_label: 宿主独立性(无 multica / issue 身份 / cwd / root 注入)
nodes.rationale: 核心保持宿主无关，组件只拿窄 capability；必须用中性宿主真实 harness 验证，纯正则扫描不算验收。

nodes.label: host-visible ask/reply ref 信任边界
nodes.norm_label: host-visible ask/reply ref 信任边界
nodes.rationale: host-visible ref 只证明消息投递到宿主可见表面，不证明作者是真人或用户已阅读；缺失、重复、跨轮或跨 run 复用全部失败。代理生成、默认值和自报不能替代真实 reply。

nodes.label: interaction-completion.v1 真实逐题交互记录
nodes.norm_label: interaction-completion.v1 真实逐题交互记录
nodes.rationale: 不保存完整问题卡原文，只保存 card hash、格式检查、选中项和 ask/reply/re-rank 顺序：在不落盘秘密与完整对话的前提下证明交互真实发生。

nodes.label: 风险驱动窄测试与 RED→GREEN 纪律
nodes.norm_label: 风险驱动窄测试与 red→green 纪律
nodes.rationale: 每个行为改动先用最窄 RED 证明缺陷再用同文件 GREEN；不默认运行全量测试，最终是否广覆盖由 T076 按实际风险单独说明，降低成本与等待。

nodes.label: 原 task 真实 revision 与处理组 1 重放
nodes.norm_label: 原 task 真实 revision 与处理组 1 重放
nodes.rationale: 只生成 replay 计划或恢复命令不算交付：必须在原 review-foundation-baseline task 上真实创建新 revision/attempt 并实际重放处理组 1，同时保留旧失败 attempt/review。

nodes.label: plan-task-contract.v1 可执行 plan/tasks 契约
nodes.norm_label: plan-task-contract.v1 可执行 plan/tasks 契约
nodes.rationale: Phase 六段、task 必填字段、命令/oracle、DAG 与 61 FR/53 AC 双向映射由确定性 validator 提供事实；provider pass 不能覆盖结构缺口。

nodes.label: 有限 review 成本策略（零 provider resolution / 一次结构 full）
nodes.norm_label: 有限 review 成本策略(零 provider resolution / 一次结构 full)
nodes.rationale: 普通文档修改不再次调用 provider；重大结构变化最多补一次完整审查；build-code 每次修复仍完整审查到 pass，避免重复花费同时不伪造 verdict。

nodes.label: review-delta-resolution.v1 零 provider 普通修改证明
nodes.norm_label: review-delta-resolution.v1 零 provider 普通修改证明
nodes.rationale: 只能由 TaskKernel 绑定并推进同一 flow，structural_change=false 且 provider_calls=0；不能伪造新 verdict，也不能用于 build-code 修复或重大结构变化。

nodes.label: TaskKernel 唯一 review flow/root/head/CAS 权威 (review-flow.v1)
nodes.norm_label: taskkernel 唯一 review flow/root/head/cas 权威 (review-flow.v1)
nodes.rationale: 复用稳定 external runner 已完成的 authority，不重建平行实现；previous_result_ref 只做 compare-and-swap 或旧接口兼容断言，caller 不能自行创建 root 或选择 head。

nodes.label: risk-acceptance.v1 append-only 风险记录
nodes.rationale: 必须绑定具体 finding/review/snapshot/reply，不得保存秘密、不得承载 decision coverage omission，也不放行结构错误。

nodes.label: 严重 finding 默认暂停与明确风险承担
nodes.norm_label: 严重 finding 默认暂停与明确风险承担
nodes.rationale: 暂停是有证据的异常处置点，不是常规质量门：只对有效 actionable major/blocking 触发，笼统“用户同意”不能放行，risk acceptance 不改变 verdict、不跨快照复用。

nodes.label: 宪法审查先于 RSK 实现的强制顺序
nodes.norm_label: 宪法审查先于 rsk 实现的强制顺序

nodes.label: 同源双视图完成事实 (stage-completion-facts.v1)
nodes.rationale: 选择一份 facts + 两个 renderer 而非两份独立内容，防止用户总结与系统交接漂移；renderer 只允许格式化，不允许重新计算事实。

nodes.label: 文档内容契约校验器 (runtime/stage/stage-content-contracts.mjs)
nodes.rationale: 只判断结构、身份、顺序、绑定和映射，不判断自然语言质量；返回 {ok, errors, facts}，ok 是内容结构事实而由 audit-aggregator 决定过程 verdict。

nodes.label: 审查暂停与风险处置组件 (runtime/review/stage-review-disposition.mjs)
nodes.norm_label: 审查暂停与风险处置组件 (runtime/review/stage-review-disposition.mjs)
nodes.rationale: 只选择 actionable + major|blocking + valid evidence 的 finding；模块不能推进 review head 或改 verdict。invalid/unavailable/timeout 不算可执行严重 finding。

nodes.label: typed content evidence 窄封套 (stage-content-evidence.v1)
nodes.rationale: 选择 allowlisted typed envelope 而非任意 JSON payload：多 schema 换来确定性可验证的边界，未知 kind 被拒绝。

Local test coverage for this path is zero, so a new narrow regression test is mandatory.

nodes.label: Blocker 3: spec-analyze silently skips the content convergence check
nodes.norm_label: blocker 3: spec-analyze silently skips the content convergence check
nodes.rationale: The gate folds 'material missing' and 'material is not prose' into one silent branch with no else, so the skip never reaches errors/facts. Fix = emit an explicit readable skip fact; cost = the only existing test currently freezes the silent-skip behaviour and must be updated explicitly rather than loosened.

nodes.label: Frozen 16-Key Stage Row Field Table (STAGE_ROW_KEYS)
nodes.rationale: The exact-key check throws when the key set differs from the frozen table, which is precisely why 'add a material_scope field' was never an option and why several candidate fixes are constrained to rewriting write-side or read-side logic.

nodes.label: Blocker 1: stage row material digest uni-vs-quad-vector stale (permanently unreadable)
nodes.norm_label: blocker 1: stage row material digest uni-vs-quad-vector stale (permanently unreadable)
nodes.rationale: Deterministically reproduced twice in this task itself: when the stage outcome is unavailable the writer falls back to the whole-material revision while the reader expects the one-element scope revision, so the two can never be equal and the row is permanently stale regardless of material edits. Fix direction chosen = repair the writer side only; the reader-side widening (accept both fingerprints) was rejected as relaxing the judgement.

nodes.label: D-007 Integration Order: task III build-code starts only after task II is fully merged
nodes.norm_label: d-007 integration order: task iii build-code starts only after task ii is fully merged

User added this constraint verbatim. During the wait only this task's four materials may be produced and no repository file may change; a merge-base ancestor check on task II's merge SHA is the gate.

nodes.label: Material-only review preservation
nodes.rationale: Material-only changes should preserve an already recorded review fact and avoid redispatch, while retaining the special verify-code snapshot guard.

nodes.label: Review-result deduplication
nodes.rationale: Unchanged review requests should reuse immutable canonical results; only an explicitly judged retry should create a new attempt.

nodes.label: Write identity contract
nodes.rationale: Every formal write must bind task id, canonical task path, current Git worktree root, and authenticated task workspace before producing target bytes.

nodes.label: Official acceptance derivation
nodes.rationale: Acceptance coverage must remain on the existing official derivation writer so caller payloads cannot override it and no second acceptance projection is created.

nodes.label: Authorized remote cleanup
nodes.rationale: Remote task-branch deletion is permitted only after canonical authorization and remains nested in the existing cleanup action rather than creating a new close control plane.

nodes.label: Quality evidence discipline
nodes.rationale: RED must fail at the named behavior, GREEN must use the same oracle, and unknown, unavailable, partial, and incomplete facts must stay explicit rather than becoming completion claims.

nodes.label: No new control plane
nodes.rationale: The plan preserves existing public commands, frozen schemas, and writers; cleanup and interaction changes stay within existing actions and kernel publication paths.

nodes.label: Talk/Grill/Clarify 批量 frontier 交互协议
nodes.norm_label: talk/grill/clarify 批量 frontier 交互协议
nodes.rationale: 串行逐题交互是主要时间/token 浪费；一次只问互不依赖、Agent 无法查明的问题，单题单决策轴、2～3 个有效选项，保留部分回复并重排 frontier，可降低决策成本而不取消真实 ask/wait/reply/resume 合同。

nodes.label: mini-task 精简独立功能交付流程
nodes.norm_label: mini-task 精简独立功能交付流程
nodes.rationale: 完整五阶段对边界清楚的小功能过重，聊天直改又缺质量与交付；mini-task 紧凑复用四材料、两次专用审查和真实 Git 交付，替代历史 scope_revision，但不成为第六 stage 或第五材料；范围膨胀时暂停由用户选择。

nodes.label: spec-analyze 五阶段窄一致性 profile（公共核心 + requirement-lineage）
nodes.norm_label: spec-analyze 五阶段窄一致性 profile(公共核心 + requirement-lineage)
nodes.rationale: 复用现有 spec-analyze 单入口与 requirement-lineage：维护成本最低，避免五个相邻入口或五套规则漂移；必须先修复 build-plan 声明调用但运行时未调用/测试反向禁止的现有矛盾（R-016、R-097）。

nodes.label: 最小 step outcome 事实（step_id/status/输入/结果/证据/原因）
nodes.norm_label: 最小 step outcome 事实(step_id/status/输入/结果/证据/原因)
nodes.rationale: 历史 M15 故障显示 manifest 声明不等于真实执行、stage 绿色会掩盖 step 静默丢失；用既有 facts 承载最小 outcome，缺失乱序可被发现，但不新增 ledger 或 gate。

nodes.label: 通用 wh-review 三次 fresh 异源请求与 SAME_SOURCE fallback
nodes.norm_label: 通用 wh-review 三次 fresh 异源请求与 same_source fallback
nodes.rationale: provider 故障不得让重要 review step 被跳过或伪装完成，也不能无限冻结任务；同一 snapshot 上最多三次新的公开异源请求，仍失败只用当前 provider 独立子代理并如实标记，质量保持 incomplete，带风险交付需另行接受。

nodes.label: DEC-001 Stage Agent 执行，runtime 只认证并透传 outcome
nodes.norm_label: dec-001 stage agent 执行,runtime 只认证并透传 outcome
nodes.rationale: 补足真实证据链但不建设第二套工作流引擎：只认证现有 manifest ID 与 evidence ref/hash，拒绝调用方自报 executed，缺证据保持 missing/unknown。

nodes.label: DEC-002 runReview 单 attempt，CLI 组合三次 fresh 公开请求
nodes.norm_label: dec-002 runreview 单 attempt,cli 组合三次 fresh 公开请求
nodes.rationale: 不改 3rd-review 私有 lifecycle、不做隐藏 retry，而用现有公开请求原语满足恢复要求，使每次 attempt 都可回放；SAME_SOURCE 或漂移 packet 不得计为异源成功。

nodes.label: DEC-003 mini-task 是非 stage 薄 skill，不是第六 stage
nodes.norm_label: dec-003 mini-task 是非 stage 薄 skill,不是第六 stage
nodes.rationale: 复用 bootstrap/workspace/四材料 writer/review/task-close，仅补薄顺序编排；不伪造 verify-code completion，不新增 proof mode 或任务关系对象。

nodes.label: Stage outcome bridge：内容寻址 stage-outcomes 记录与唯一接线
nodes.norm_label: stage outcome bridge:内容寻址 stage-outcomes 记录与唯一接线
nodes.rationale: Stage Agent 用 publishCanonicalRecord 写 quality/evidence/stage-outcomes/<stage>/<sha256>.json，officialStageHandler 用现有 task record 做 hash/snapshot/manifest 认证后透传，stageMonitoringFacts 保持唯一 consumer；retry 不覆盖旧记录，无记录时仍输出 missing/unknown。

nodes.label: FR-GOV-001 只复用四材料/facts/lineage/七类 public runtime
nodes.norm_label: fr-gov-001 只复用四材料/facts/lineage/七类 public runtime

nodes.rationale: 能力已验证（F-001/F-002），缺的是可复查证据，因此判据定为 roadmap M17a/M17b 十条验收逐条有最小留证（一个汇总文档/一个测试文件/一次存档输出），使 M17 可宣告完成且 M18 不被卡；被拒方案：严格留证过重、记录全砍卡住 M18、折中砍半缺两条验收。风险：「从简」滑向「不做」，已写入失败边界防线。

nodes.norm_label: d-009 孤儿三技能删二留一

nodes.norm_label: d-010 显式身份与 stage agent outcome(不读宿主 transcript)

nodes.norm_label: def-001 延期 f1(多 cli seam 泛化 + cli_map + kimi)

nodes.norm_label: f-002 多 cli 兼容现状(仅 codex+dsh 接入 runtime)

nodes.norm_label: phase b3 多 cli 批

nodes.label: Phase B5 M17 当前质量事实补录
nodes.norm_label: phase b5 m17 当前质量事实补录

nodes.label: RISK-P-02 Claude 宿主未提交结构化 outcome 或绑定不匹配
nodes.norm_label: risk-p-02 claude 宿主未提交结构化 outcome 或绑定不匹配
nodes.rationale: 若错误兜底会伪造阶段完成，因此缺结果保持 unavailable、绑定失败原样保留并停止该次事实写入，禁止从 transcript 或评论反推；验证靠显式身份完整/部分/冲突/无认证上下文与 bridge 缺字段负例断言。

nodes.norm_label: phase 1 正式入口与 canonical facts
nodes.rationale: 先证明正式 public run 在成功/失败/缺 outcome 三条路径都真实建立 facts store 并落 source status，再谈投影与页面；直接 sidecar 不能作为入口证明。

nodes.label: Phase 2 projection、诊断与四区页面
nodes.rationale: project/global/data.js/HTML 全是 derived；分母与 required fields 必须由 projection 提供，不能让页面自行猜测，partial 只表示记录或投影不完整而非流程退化。

nodes.label: Phase 3 正常会话自动 outcome 与正式验收
nodes.norm_label: phase 3 正常会话自动 outcome 与正式验收
nodes.rationale: 用户正常使用的 WorkflowHub 会话就是执行入口；不要求另开 Stage Agent，Codex host 能力未证明时如实保留 incomplete/unavailable，不把测试或历史记录写成生产完成。

nodes.label: plan-task.v3 执行任务卡合同
nodes.rationale: 任务完成状态只由各卡“执行状态填写区”记录；build-plan 不勾选完成、不写执行命令结果、不提前填 review/verify 事实，以避免计划材料冒充执行事实。

nodes.label: review unavailable 如实记录
nodes.rationale: provider 或配置不可用只记为 unavailable（如 OUTPUT_INVALID、snapshot_or_material_identity_unavailable），不重审追 pass、不换执行者、不把 unavailable 改写成质量通过。

nodes.label: sample sufficiency 与固定分母
nodes.rationale: in_scope_task_count 是范围事实而非全库记录数；缺分母或字段身份时必须 unknown/insufficient，单 bucket 不能称趋势，count<2 不能称常见。

nodes.label: 精确 session-id locator 跨 cwd 复用
nodes.norm_label: 精确 session-id locator 跨 cwd 复用
nodes.rationale: 旧实现按 cwd 哈希 state path，导致同一真实 Codex source 在阶段切换后丢失（后四阶段 no_registered_source）；改为精确定位 locator 只存位置不复制事件，未知/失效 locator fail-closed 为 unregistered。

nodes.label: spec/plan sha256 版本绑定
nodes.rationale: 每张卡以 artifact_kind/ref/hash 绑定 spec 与 plan；hash 是材料身份而非进度，材料变化即读为 stale。

nodes.label: public stage-runtime run 入口
nodes.rationale: public run 是唯一被承认的正式入口证据；它必须在进 sidecar 前初始化 facts store，并把同一 cwd 继续传入会话 outcome 读取器以防串入别的 task。

nodes.label: T014 正常会话自动产出 current stage outcome
nodes.norm_label: t014 正常会话自动产出 current stage outcome
nodes.rationale: 只有正常 WorkflowHub 会话自动产生的 outcome 才算生产证据；手工构造、fixture、旧记录或 session 扫描都不能冒充，缺自动 caller 时保持 incomplete。

nodes.label: task-bootstrap 会话自动绑定
nodes.rationale: 正常会话由 task-bootstrap 绑定到真实 task，后续 step/skill/spec-analyze 事件不再要求手填 task-id；已有其他 task 绑定时入口直接拒绝，避免串写。

nodes.label: TaskKernel 认证写入路径
nodes.rationale: 宿主 outcome 只经既有 TaskKernel 认证、绑定并写入，禁止 fixture、session 扫描、路径猜测和第二套 writer。

nodes.label: M15 真实记录链与看板交付修复：执行任务
nodes.norm_label: m15 真实记录链与看板交付修复:执行任务

nodes.label: tools/cli/append-lesson-observation.mjs 无条件追加 CLI
nodes.rationale: 机器零 AI 成本无条件追加 raw_observation，写回与复盘成败解耦以防污染（FND-004/D-007）；合并去重写回 merged_lesson 不在此 CLI，而由复盘会话按 SKILL.md 协议执行。

nodes.label: tools/cli/build-reflection-page.mjs 判断层页面投影器
nodes.norm_label: tools/cli/build-reflection-page.mjs 判断层页面投影器
nodes.rationale: 生成仓外 data.js 与单文件静态 HTML，零 AI 聚合（M0，AC-010）；unknown/unavailable/degraded/failed/empty 各态如实呈现且不补零，投影失败显示 fatal/stale 不用陈旧数据冒充。

nodes.label: tools/cli/derive-consumption-edges.mjs 消费边派生
nodes.rationale: 纯脚本只读重算消费边，零 AI 成本；保守语义：无引用记 unknown 而非判无用，引用未登记/记录缺失/历史任务一律 unknown。

nodes.label: tools/cli/validate-stage-reflection.mjs 确定性校验器
nodes.rationale: 机器强制核验兜底自评偏差（RISK-001）：缺 remove 双硬信号即改写降级为 needs_evidence 并记录降级事实；只读事实源、不做质量打分、不阻断流程。

nodes.label: AC-001 deferred_to_next_real_task
nodes.rationale: 构造场景不得冒充真实任务背书（M15 空壳教训）；AC-001 需真实任务端到端并由用户审查判断质量后确认回填，close 前不标绿。

nodes.label: human-confirmation.v3（reply_text + step_slug）
nodes.rationale: 单写入源升级（禁双写，G-001）：confirm 写入点新增用户回复原文与 step 锚点以支持介入归因；读取方只读兼容 v1/v2/v3，历史记录不改写不回填，旧记录介入原文能力如实降级。

nodes.label: 判断层（judgment）vs 事实层（fact）
nodes.rationale: 判断层是 LLM 归因记录、record_kind=judgment、非机器事实、不作质量裁决；事实层为机器采集的物理事实。区分写死以免 judgment 被当作质量结论。

nodes.label: lessons JSONL 读写约定（raw_observation / merged_lesson）
nodes.norm_label: lessons jsonl 读写约定(raw_observation / merged_lesson)
nodes.rationale: 无条件追加不改写既有行；失败路径只追加 raw 不产 merged，冷启动从零积累（G-003）。

nodes.label: Phase 0 硬约束：m15-retirement 合并 main 复核
nodes.norm_label: phase 0 硬约束:m15-retirement 合并 main 复核
nodes.rationale: 禁止关键词放行：五项证据化核验（监控四件套 absent、保留符号 present、分类器、diff 摘要、用户确认）须由 gate 逐条机器复验，五项未齐前 build-code 不得开工。

nodes.label: docs/architecture/move-map.json 登记
nodes.rationale: 新增生产文件必须登记唯一 consumer、owner 与删除条件；页面 CLI 条目注明替代 ADR 0012 退役条目。

nodes.label: on_stage_end / blocking 声明式调度语义
nodes.norm_label: on_stage_end / blocking 声明式调度语义
nodes.rationale: 普通 step 语义两头堵（失败 stage 轮不到复盘、复盘失败拖挂 stage），故裁决 P-002 由 runner 小幅扩展：on_stage_end 无论前置成败都执行，blocking:false 失败只记 outcome 不翻转 stage 完成状态、不阻断 close。

nodes.label: 页面真实浏览器 QA 证据（截图 + 操作日志）
nodes.norm_label: 页面真实浏览器 qa 证据(截图 + 操作日志)
nodes.rationale: 字段存在不算数，真实数据驱动渲染才算（失败边界②）；禁止仅以测试断言充当浏览器证据，QA 仍只是构造 fixture 证据而非 AC-001。

nodes.label: provenance 与历史事实只读保留
nodes.norm_label: provenance 与历史事实只读保留
nodes.rationale: 只读兼容不得改写历史 v1/v2 记录或回填；断言更新须逐条记录理由，不得掩盖真实回归。

nodes.label: RED/GREEN 配对门禁（同一 gate_cmd 与 oracle）
nodes.norm_label: red/green 配对门禁(同一 gate_cmd 与 oracle)
nodes.rationale: F9 要求行为变更先 RED 再 GREEN；RED 失败必须来自目标行为缺失而非语法/环境，否则 oracle 区分。

nodes.label: remove 双硬信号门槛
nodes.rationale: 仅当 30 天窗口内零消费 ∧（人工 rejected ∨ 同 step_slug 重复介入≥2）同时成立才保留 remove_candidate；双硬信号不齐只能 needs_evidence，unknown≠零消费。

nodes.label: runner 机器前奏（执行复盘技能前自动追加 raw）
nodes.norm_label: runner 机器前奏(执行复盘技能前自动追加 raw)
nodes.rationale: 技能超时/未启动/失败三场景下 raw 观察已落盘，因而不依赖主会话是否启动技能；前奏自身失败只记 outcome，不阻断。

nodes.label: RISK-001 自评偏差
nodes.rationale: LLM 自评判断不可信，故由确定性校验器强制降级兜底而非信任模型输出。

nodes.label: skills/stage-reflection/（SKILL.md + skill-bundle.json）
nodes.rationale: 技能只产出 judgment 文件与 lessons 写回；不写 facts、不做质量裁决、不阻断任何流程；catalog bundle hash 须与实际 bundle 条目同步。

nodes.label: stage outcome 记录（quality/evidence/stage-outcomes）
nodes.rationale: 消费边派生输入：step_outcomes[i].input_refs 为字符串数组、evidence_refs 为 {ref,sha256} 对象数组，两种形态分别处理不得混用。

nodes.label: stage-reflection 每阶段自动复盘器
nodes.norm_label: stage-reflection 每阶段自动复盘器
nodes.rationale: 每 stage 既有 step 序列完成后由主会话执行复盘，不另起子代理、不读 transcript 与四份材料全文；自评偏差由机器门槛兜底（RISK-001），失败不阻断 stage/close。

nodes.label: runtime/schemas/stage-reflection.v1.json
nodes.rationale: record_kind 固定 judgment、classification 七取值，禁止任何质量打分字段（score/grade/quality），以免判断层退化为质量结论。

nodes.label: storageRoot/Projects/<proj>/lessons/<stage>.jsonl
nodes.rationale: 仓外 lessons 存储使经验跨任务积累；--root 显式传参兜底不同宿主的 storageRoot 解析差异。

nodes.label: verify-code 异源审查 unavailable 保真
nodes.norm_label: verify-code 异源审查 unavailable 保真
nodes.rationale: provider 不可用/无效输出（PROVIDER_OUTPUT_INVALID、PUBLIC_RESULT_INVALID、PROCESS_EXIT_NONZERO）如实记 unavailable，不换成执行者、不重复审查、不把空 findings 改写为通过；质量状态保持 incomplete。

nodes.label: 任务清单：stage-reflection 每阶段自动复盘器与判断层页面
nodes.norm_label: 任务清单:stage-reflection 每阶段自动复盘器与判断层页面

nodes.norm_label: ac 全量映射表(12 行,证据路径逐行指向)
nodes.rationale: M15 空壳教训——映射表每行必须指向真实存在的证据文件，构造场景与真实证据分列标注。

nodes.label: plan.md 裁决 P-001（verify-code 也挂载复盘）
nodes.norm_label: plan.md 裁决 p-001(verify-code 也挂载复盘)

nodes.label: plan.md 裁决 P-002（runner 小幅扩展）
nodes.norm_label: plan.md 裁决 p-002(runner 小幅扩展)

nodes.norm_label: ac 覆盖度清单(ac-01~ac-04:0 covered / 3 partial / 1 not_covered)

nodes.label: fresh-capture.json 豁免记录（doc-only 变更跳过 fresh 测试）
nodes.norm_label: fresh-capture.json 豁免记录(doc-only 变更跳过 fresh 测试)

nodes.norm_label: git-authorize.mjs 授权记录/消费工具

nodes.rationale: 固定来源是方法依据，不证明本次已获得行为效果；迭代时核上游更新/更优候选并说明实际差异与本地偏离，不自动追 HEAD。

nodes.label: Task graph 与 context pointers
nodes.rationale: Phase 内的 Task 是 task graph 而非可跳过依赖的步骤表：只从阻塞边已满足的 frontier 取任务，生产者先于消费者，重活在独立上下文完成，主会话只收实际结果与原 ref。

nodes.norm_label: spec.md(产品规格与全局实现设计)

nodes.norm_label: decision-log.md(用户确认的方向决策日志)

nodes.norm_label: deep-research 技能(r0-r5 研究契约)

nodes.norm_label: 方向地图与 fog(destination/notes/decisions so far/not yet specified/out of scope 五段)

nodes.norm_label: grill-with-docs 技能(交互质询 + 领域术语维护)

nodes.norm_label: spec-analyze 技能(stage 末一致性核对)

nodes.label: stage-handoff 技能（人读交接）
nodes.rationale: handoff 是人读进度载体，必须实际执行并报告方法返回的实际不可变绝对路径；披露不代替完成，交接执行不是门，不要求固定机器复盘或交接认证。

nodes.label: stage-reflection 技能（stage 末可选复盘）
nodes.norm_label: stage-reflection 技能(stage 末可选复盘)

nodes.label: wh-review 技能（独立审查，Long-review host convention）
nodes.norm_label: wh-review 技能(独立审查,long-review host convention)

nodes.label: 一次架构机会评估（deletion test / 架构词表）
nodes.norm_label: 一次架构机会评估(deletion test / 架构词表)

nodes.label: 终末独立代码审查（OCR 多 provider 路）
nodes.norm_label: 终末独立代码审查(ocr 多 provider 路)
nodes.rationale: 本步完成以每路 provider 的原始 findings 或真实失败/取消/unavailable、实际执行者与覆盖限制均已保存且可定位为准，缺一路即未完成；首个 provider 到终态后立即处理，迟到 findings 交给同一回调，不能因首个结果取消 sibling。

nodes.norm_label: build-code skill-deps.yaml(12 技能 + 5 runtime + 3 external 能力)

nodes.norm_label: make-decision 工作流(skill v3.2.0,十五步方法)

nodes.norm_label: verify-code skill-deps.yaml(7 技能 + 5 runtime + 2 external 能力)

nodes.label: Plain-Language Chat Acceptance Report
nodes.rationale: Symmetric compression and main-session authorship both have a whitening entry point (a parent session reported 148/148 green and was overturned by its own independent reviewer); an asymmetric structure that enumerates failures verbatim removes the美化 space without becoming a gate, since blocking gates would have failed 562/707 recorded stage results.

nodes.label: Four Measured Parallel Disciplines
nodes.rationale: Audits quantified the waste: subagent inheritance of the full parent transcript was 42% of session input, idle polling 27% of tokens, cross-phase full snapshot binding 60-90 minutes per session, and repeated reads/runs up to 28x; these four evidence-backed rules are promoted over the SD-11 five-piece set, which is demoted to a parallel clause.

nodes.label: Dispatch by Work Type Across Five Stages
nodes.norm_label: dispatch by work type across five stages
nodes.rationale: Dispatch unit is work type (implementation/test/review/repair), not process step number; repair returns to the same subagent session so one implementation never gets a second executorship, and the main session only dispatches, harvests and runs interactive skills.

nodes.label: Cross-Language Writing Rules (ASD-STE100 / ISO 24495-1)
nodes.rationale: The worktree decision-log measured 1,854 lines / 326,870 B before rewriting versus 549 lines / 80,492 B after; growth was per-line content, so only cross-language rules were taken and the English permitted-word list plus word/sentence hard limits were discarded. Where STE and ISO conflict, ISO decides what counts as a good document.

nodes.label: ASD-STE100
nodes.rationale: 被引为文档规范检查的思想来源之一，其核心思想落成中文可执行规则时只做可机械判定的部分；中文句长阈值不得直接沿用外部语料的数字，须先用本仓既有产物重新校准。

nodes.label: ISO 24495-1:2023
nodes.rationale: 被引为标准来源之一；ISO 自己也只否定「用可读性公式当判据」，因此只报告不阻断的本决定不构成对 docs/adr/0037 的推翻。

nodes.label: 仍附字节的三类例外
nodes.rationale: 例外仅三类仍附字节：该文件随后会被改动或删除、外部服务返回体、一次性环境读数。不新增去重校验器或检查工具，不设数量阈值或篇幅指标，不在本轮清理历史产物（历史清账需另开明确授权并逐件复核）。

nodes.label: 证明范围只写路径 + hash，字节留在工作树
nodes.norm_label: 证明范围只写路径 + hash,字节留在工作树
nodes.rationale: 原口径要求把本 Phase 实际改动文件的原始字节连同路径与 hash 一起保存；与「每类事实只留一份原始件」相乘后无法收敛，产物规模以数量级增长而重复存证没有消费者。改为只写路径 + hash 换取收敛，代价是可核性：工作树被改动或清理后仅凭路径与 hash 无法再核内容。

nodes.label: 同一事实＝字节相同（复用判据保守）
nodes.norm_label: 同一事实=字节相同(复用判据保守)
nodes.rationale: 重跑得到逐字节相同的结果时复用既有原件、只写引用不新写；只有在命令逐字相同、既有 ref 存在且能确立内容相等时才复用。无法确立内容相等时保留新件并记 deduplication: unknown，不得据字节数判定为重复。真实失败、取消、超时与迟到发现永不因复用被抹掉，被 ref 指向的件一律按唯一原件保留。

nodes.label: content_sha256 仅对字节级 vendored 项成立且必须复算回填
nodes.norm_label: content_sha256 仅对字节级 vendored 项成立且必须复算回填
nodes.rationale: 新增字段只有两个且条件式必填：adopted（用了哪些内容）与 content_sha256；后者仅对字节级 vendored 项成立（当前本仓只有 frontend-component-quality 一项），必须由检查器复算回填、禁止手工填写。给全部 adapted 项加内容哈希会撞上 docs/adr/0013——该 ADR 因「手工同步必然遗漏、保留即保留缺陷」已删除 catalog 的 local_bundle_hash／snapshot_sha256 并明文拒绝收敛到单一来源；新增独立检查工具则会造出无真实 consumer 的新控制面。取舍代价：18 条 adapted 项仍无内容哈希，且哈希只能证明 pin 未被替换、发现不了上游发新版（上游漂移检测默认不跑）。

nodes.label: 一致性检查追加进 reports，永不进 failures
nodes.norm_label: 一致性检查追加进 reports,永不进 failures
nodes.rationale: 检查追加进 tools/cli/check-skill-consistency.mjs 现有的 reports 数组，永不进 failures、不动退出码——只报告不阻断，避免把来源登记变成新的质量门。

nodes.label: 先用零新增字段报出已有缺陷
nodes.norm_label: 先用零新增字段报出已有缺陷
nodes.rationale: 外部技能来源登记的处理顺序定为先用零新增字段把已有缺陷报出来，再谈新增字段；实测这一步就能报出 skills/catalog.yaml:456 与 :470 两条 status: adapted 却 upstream: [] 的真实自相矛盾。

nodes.label: 只报告不阻断的文档规范检查器
nodes.norm_label: 只报告不阻断的文档规范检查器
nodes.rationale: 不评分、默认退出码 0、不接任何 stage／gate／CI 失败路径、未跑即 unknown（不得读成通过）、只查可机械判定的项、阈值可注入。只写指引不做检查是现状：唯一规范 WR001 的到达条件是「创建或改写 agent 方法时」，写 spec.md／decision-log.md／prd.md 时字面不触发，36 处指针 + 零挂载 + 零可执行事实，要求在物理上不可观测——实测这就是要求被遗失的直接原因。做成阻断门则宪法与 docs/adr/0037 均禁止。取舍：在最强约束（阻断）与零约束（只写指引）之间选中间档，代价是需要有人看检查结果，不看就等于多了一份没人读的输出，必须承认为弱点。挂载点必须是文档输出物必经之处（模板骨架 + 常驻入口 + 检查器三件套）。

nodes.label: 不可靠项明确不查并如实说明
nodes.norm_label: 不可靠项明确不查并如实说明
nodes.rationale: 缩写全称、指代、长定语、被动语态等实测精确率只有 0%–35%，明确不查；一段一主题与一句一事只能靠模板骨架，不得假装机器管住了。与 docs/adr/0037 的关系必须逐条记帐：0037 逐字否掉的是评分器与字数门，不是「任何检查」。

nodes.label: UI 规范八类（领域语义／视觉／组件／布局／交互／工程／内容／质量）
nodes.norm_label: ui 规范八类(领域语义/视觉/组件/布局/交互/工程/内容/质量)
nodes.rationale: 本入口只定位来源、接线专业 owner、显露缺口；八类正文由各事实原专业 owner 生成或维护，文件名只是缺少同职责实质来源时的默认落点，有等价内容就复用。来源记录类、实际路径与稳定 section/page anchor、作用域、version、owner、真实 consumer、适用或冲突与影响。精确 token/CSS 数值、API、资产和上游原件留在原位只引用；安全隐私、无障碍、国际化、响应式极值、性能及竞态横贯原专业 owner 与项目基础规范，不新增第九规范平台。

nodes.label: Phase P1 — Bundle/catalog skill closure
nodes.rationale: Sequenced first because stage-runtime facts can only depend on a reusable, locatable skill closure; the STOP condition forbids a new catalog, a second bundle generator, a permanent hash updater or a fifth stage, and a RED caused by setup failure must not proceed to GREEN.

nodes.label: Phase P2 — Single writer and narrow bridge
nodes.norm_label: phase p2 — single writer and narrow bridge
nodes.rationale: Runs second because review/completion cannot meaningfully judge provenance until the formal writer and bridge identity are closed; must stop immediately if any non-stage-runtime path can still write current quality or if a new state machine, second store or permanent compatibility chain would be required.

nodes.label: Phase P3 — Review provenance and legacy completion
nodes.norm_label: phase p3 — review provenance and legacy completion
nodes.rationale: Closes review provenance, requiredness, freshness and legacy readers; the same current-provenance fixture covers both the handler and freshness paths so the two cannot diverge, and legacy bytes must stay unchanged.

nodes.label: Phase P4 — Plan aggregate and handoff (non-behavior)
nodes.norm_label: phase p4 — plan aggregate and handoff (non-behavior)
nodes.rationale: Explicitly not a new behavior phase: it only aggregates the current snapshot and hands risks/unknowns to build-code, with all source tests READ ONLY and the sole NEW artifact being runtime-generated evidence, so a plan-level structural check cannot be mistaken for implementation completion.

nodes.label: Current completion truth table and aggregate priority
nodes.norm_label: current completion truth table and aggregate priority
nodes.rationale: D-007: completion predicates need current facts, so legacy or missing facts cannot satisfy them; the fixed aggregation order is snapshot/material/provenance -> required step/skill -> review and finding disposition -> stage-specific predicate -> handoff, and no later status may override an earlier failure. Required skills/steps must be completed, not_applicable requires trigger=false and executed=false, and unavailable/unknown/incomplete are preserved as-is.

nodes.label: Stable idempotency key, replay conflict and partial-write contract
nodes.norm_label: stable idempotency key, replay conflict and partial-write contract
nodes.rationale: Retries, duplicates and replays must not create a second canonical fact: the key is SHA-256 over the canonical narrow-outcome fields, same key plus same bytes replays to the same reference with zero delta, a byte conflict fails as BRIDGE_REPLAY_CONFLICT, and an interrupted partial write may only be recovered atomically under the same key or stay incomplete/unknown.

nodes.label: Legacy evidence read-only boundary
nodes.rationale: G-001: 'old evidence may be displayed' and 'old evidence may complete' are different claims; display is read-only while current completion consumes only current hash/snapshot/quality facts. Old records are never auto-rebound, written back or substituted for current review/AC/human confirmation.

nodes.label: Narrow bridge outcome contract
nodes.rationale: The bridge must not copy stage-completion logic or own the quality namespace: it may only carry schema_version/task_id/stage/attempt_id/outcome_ref/outcome_sha256/outcome_status/producer, and every illegal lifecycle case (out-of-order, duplicate, time overlap or clock rollback, missing package, identity mismatch) returns a deterministic failed/unavailable with zero current-quality delta.

nodes.label: Broker-provenance wh-review layering (dsh = diagnostic only)
nodes.rationale: D-004: a local/self review has no foreign provenance, so it cannot satisfy a formal quality conclusion; only a canonical broker-provenance wh-review bound to the current snapshot/material/review-track may enter verify-code.code_review, and dsh-code-review results stay diagnostic inputs. Provider unavailability stays unavailable rather than becoming empty findings.

nodes.label: Single canonical quality writer (stage-runtime/TaskKernel)
nodes.rationale: D-006: multiple writers let the same fact be overwritten or forked, destroying immutable lineage; therefore all non-stage-runtime writes to the current quality namespace must be explicitly rejected with a zero current-quality delta, while legacy reads and isolated fixtures move to non-current paths instead of a permanent double-write compatibility bridge.

nodes.label: Skill closure consistency (bundle/catalog/release/resolver)
nodes.rationale: D-005: the current problem is hash/closure drift, not a missing second release system, so the existing bundle generator/catalog/local resolver/closure checker are reused as the single closure owner and only contract tests plus negative cases are added; a second bundle truth, manual hash updater or replacement catalog is explicitly rejected.

nodes.norm_label: d-003 强化现有 completion 派生而不新增推进 gate

nodes.norm_label: d-004 方向变化在同一 task 重编当前材料

nodes.norm_label: d-005 stage 专项语义审查,不重写 wh-review 合同
nodes.rationale: prompt/合同已多轮优化但问题复现，根因在解析、执行、绑定、消费和完成判据；优先修生产链，仅在 fixture 证明具体漏检时窄改 prompt。

nodes.rationale: stage 自己最了解当前产物，stage-end 当场发现/修复成本最低；close 只汇总和做物理边界，避免末端堆积质量债。

nodes.norm_label: d-008 前四 stage 用 spec-analyze,verify-code 用专用 code-review closure
nodes.rationale: authoring 产物需要跨材料语义检查，代码风险需要真实实现审查；两者均进入当前 stage completion，避免重复检查和新维护面。

nodes.norm_label: d-009 registered transcript 验证投影核对 decision-log 需求全集

nodes.norm_label: d-010 analyzer finding 在当前 stage 修复而非阻塞

nodes.norm_label: d-012 本任务不启动真实 talk/clarify 交互验收
