nodes.rationale: 把「门禁」与「记录」分开：revision 绑定、快照认证、材料身份/hash、回执校验不再构成推进前置；唯一物理不可行是任务身份/worktree 建不起来、没有记录落点；材料字节不可读只让依赖其内容的动作局部失败；换取「不因缺步/乱序阻断推进」，代价是材料偷换无机器防护（RK-003）。

nodes.label: D-003 任务类型声明位置与状态落点（受控值契约）
nodes.norm_label: d-003 任务类型声明位置与状态落点(受控值契约)
nodes.rationale: 入口不新增类型参数以避免同一事实两处声明，沿用现有「声明+读回」reader 契约（readTaskTypeFromDecisionLog）意味着不需要新 schema 或新控制面；受控值恰为 {规划任务, 普通任务}，固定标签在 decision-log 任务身份段恰好一条。

nodes.label: D-006 规划旅程真接线：让 build-prd 进入可执行阶段范围
nodes.norm_label: d-006 规划旅程真接线:让 build-prd 进入可执行阶段范围
nodes.rationale: build-prd 被硬编码五阶段清单与 8 处排除点挡住，不接线则 AC-01 拿不到真实执行记录；只放行「可执行」、不加入正式阶段集合、不改其六步内容，以免与 build-prd SKILL 自证约束相冲。

nodes.label: D-007 审查复用缺陷：材料身份变化不得复用旧审查
nodes.norm_label: d-007 审查复用缺陷:材料身份变化不得复用旧审查
nodes.rationale: findReusableReview 复用键不含 materialId，材料变更后仍 reused:true 且 findings 指向旧材料，违反 CONTEXT.md 的「大纲变更后旧审查作废」；用户裁定在本卡分支修掉，否则前序任务全被同一缺陷卡住；整体审查链替换仍归 CARD-05。

nodes.label: D-008 规划旅程终止语义（五元：边界/状态/记录/失败/并存）
nodes.norm_label: d-008 规划旅程终止语义(五元:边界/状态/记录/失败/并存)
nodes.rationale: AC-01 要求规划任务「到 build-prd 结束且无第三阶段」，必须有可逐字核对的终止语义，否则「停住」无法验证；build-prd 可记 succeeded/failed 但不属正式五阶段集合。

nodes.label: D-009 迁移期与四阶段生效边界（activation cohort）
nodes.norm_label: d-009 迁移期与四阶段生效边界(activation cohort)
nodes.rationale: 不让在途任务中途换轨，也不把「代码验收通过」误当「产品已启用」；创建/获得记录落点时冻结 pre/post cohort，activation 需能力验收+正式发布标识+入口实际消费三项事实，避免把两套拓扑永久化。

nodes.label: 两道人为门：推进确认（A）与不可逆 Git 授权（B）
nodes.norm_label: 两道人为门:推进确认(a)与不可逆 git 授权(b)
nodes.rationale: 宪法级边界：除 confirm 类推进确认对话与 authorize 类不可逆操作独立授权外，不得新增第三类人工准入；审批绑定由 canonical 人为确认记录承载而不在正文自证。

nodes.label: RK-001..RK-008 风险与 DF-001..DF-006 延期寄存器
nodes.norm_label: rk-001..rk-008 风险与 df-001..df-006 延期寄存器
nodes.rationale: 去阻断可能被误做成掩盖失败（RK-001）、拓扑改错代价全局（RK-002）、材料偷换无机器防护（RK-003）、接线触及核心文件（RK-005）、build-prd 内部质量无卡承接（RK-006）、外部清理静默带走未提交材料（RK-007，已实际发生）、审查复用实现全 stage 共享（RK-008）；延期项逐条指定承接卡。

nodes.label: RS-001 仓库现状盘点（8 处排除点、24/18 谓词、顺序锁与轮次）
nodes.norm_label: rs-001 仓库现状盘点(8 处排除点、24/18 谓词、顺序锁与轮次)
nodes.rationale: 证明 workflows/build-prd 存在却被 CANONICAL_STAGE_SLUGS 等 8 处硬编码名单排除、round_count 无「必须 3/4 轮」机器断言、会真正阻断推进的机器校验约 24 项——该盘点把「规划旅程不可执行」从声明变成一个可核对事实。

nodes.label: DEC-001 run 命令内 portable 分支 + 新执行链模块
nodes.norm_label: dec-001 run 命令内 portable 分支 + 新执行链模块
nodes.rationale: 选内部窄分支而非新参数/复用 dispatch-component：public 七命令面不变、正式阶段路径零改动，且 dispatch-component 的 spawn 机制与 Markdown 六步模型不匹配、core/ 为历史区禁新增能力。

nodes.label: DEC-002 任务类型读回与静态拓扑投影（纯函数）
nodes.norm_label: dec-002 任务类型读回与静态拓扑投影(纯函数)
nodes.rationale: 复用 readTaskTypeFromDecisionLog 而非新增 --type 参数（被 FR-TYPE-001 边界禁止）；拓扑必须是代码内冻结常量而非运行时拼接或配置，否则拓扑不可逐字核对。

nodes.label: DEC-003 cohort 字段落 task.json manifest + storage-root 一次性标记
nodes.norm_label: dec-003 cohort 字段落 task.json manifest + storage-root 一次性标记
nodes.rationale: facts.jsonl 被 10 键+五阶段 schema 锁死无法承载 cohort，故走 manifest 额外字段（createTask 一次写入即冻结、validateManifest 不关闭额外字段）；activation 标记三项事实任一不可验证即 fail-safe 判 pre。

nodes.label: DEC-004 build-prd 七值终态记录（portable outcome 命名空间 terminal 子面）
nodes.norm_label: dec-004 build-prd 七值终态记录(portable outcome 命名空间 terminal 子面)
nodes.rationale: build-prd 须记七值状态且与正式阶段解耦，不能进 facts.jsonl（五阶段锁）或 stage-outcomes；复用既有内容寻址追加式记录纪律，用 terminal/ 子目录 + record_kind 与 task-close 的 6 键声明面区分，不建第二状态机。

nodes.label: DEC-005 隔离与零机器门禁：静态投影 + 谓词退出推进路径
nodes.norm_label: dec-005 隔离与零机器门禁:静态投影 + 谓词退出推进路径
nodes.rationale: 隔离由结构保证（投影内无代码阶段）而非运行时特判；去门禁以「推进不被阻断」为证据、不以「校验代码不存在」为证据，物理删除归 CARD-06；任一谓词仍阻断推进则 P4 RED 保持红不回绿。

nodes.label: 8 处排除点与 18 个阻断谓词站点（24-vs-18 差异如实登记）
nodes.norm_label: 8 处排除点与 18 个阻断谓词站点(24-vs-18 差异如实登记)
nodes.rationale: build-prd 被 step-manifest/stage-context/stage-acceptance-policy/completion-predicates/stage-handlers/task-kernel-implementation/stage-agent-bridge/dispatch-component 八处名单挡住；RS-001⑤ 自称 24 项/四类却只列 5 组，plan 按 5 族逐行展开 18 个站点并把 24-vs-18 差异记为事实，不凑数、不虚构。

nodes.label: Phase P1 任务类型声明读回与入口拓扑分流
nodes.norm_label: phase p1 任务类型声明读回与入口拓扑分流
nodes.rationale: P1 必须先立：无投影则 P2 的 portable 分支无处挂、P3 的 cohort 无人读；make-decision 作为类型声明宿主阶段必须始终可执行，否则无人能澄清。

nodes.label: Phase P2 build-prd portable 执行链与终止语义
nodes.norm_label: phase p2 build-prd portable 执行链与终止语义
nodes.rationale: 执行链是规划旅程终点本体，消费 P1 投影面；终态记录内容寻址追加，修复后重跑即重入失败步，历史全保留。

nodes.label: Phase P3 activation cohort 冻结与状态事实落点
nodes.norm_label: phase p3 activation cohort 冻结与状态事实落点
nodes.rationale: cohort 消费 P1 投影读回面、状态事实消费 P2 终态记录面；标记缺失或部分事实不可验证时永远判 pre（安全侧），不 gate 任何事。

nodes.label: Phase P4 零机器门禁接线、接口蓝图公开与端到端验收
nodes.norm_label: phase p4 零机器门禁接线、接口蓝图公开与端到端验收
nodes.rationale: 去门禁改的是正式路径调用位，必须在投影/执行链冻结后做；整体串行（T007 RED → T008 GREEN → T009 FINAL），因 RED/GREEN 共享同一 gate_cmd/oracle 且蓝图文档归属 T008，故不得并行声明。

nodes.label: RED/GREEN 测试策略与 ORACLE 身份（4 contract + 1 integration + 1 acceptance）
nodes.norm_label: red/green 测试策略与 oracle 身份(4 contract + 1 integration + 1 acceptance)
nodes.rationale: 四对 RED/GREEN 共用同一 gate_cmd 与 oracle identity，只跑受影响 targeted 测试不做全量回归（AGENTS.md 测试硬规则）；RED 只接受目标断言失败或文件不存在，GREEN 保留全部负例；缺失 review/confirm/authorize 事实时对应 AC 保持 missing/unavailable，不伪造。

nodes.label: 23 条 AC 验收 oracle 与失败边界
nodes.norm_label: 23 条 ac 验收 oracle 与失败边界
nodes.rationale: 每条 AC 给出验证步骤、通过与失败判据、证据落点；失败判据专门封堵典型作弊——静态文件存在冒充真实执行、能力预演冒充 activation、缺质量事实写成质量完成、动态拼接冒充逐字拓扑。

nodes.label: Canonical gate inventory：谓词 × 转移组核对矩阵
nodes.norm_label: canonical gate inventory:谓词 × 转移组核对矩阵
nodes.rationale: 每个机器谓词必须记录现有 consumer、封闭类别、适用转移与缺失/无效时行为，每格记 missing/invalid/present/not_applicable + reason；任何 missing/invalid 不得阻断安全工作，也不得支持质量完成声明。

nodes.label: FR-FLOW / FR-GATE：清单参考语义、零机器门禁与两类人为门
nodes.norm_label: fr-flow / fr-gate:清单参考语义、零机器门禁与两类人为门
nodes.rationale: 流程清单保留为核对参考但缺步/乱序不阻断；封闭集合的机器谓词（哈希、ref/hash、snapshot、sha256、receipt、step 顺序、revision、review/test/evidence/history/inventory/complexity）不得作推进许可证且真实状态仍须记录；缺失事实不得被漂白为 pass。

nodes.label: FR-MIG-001：activation cohort（pre/post）冻结与生效条件
nodes.rationale: cohort 在创建/获得记录落点时追加冻结且此后永不被暂停/恢复/晚声明改变；activation 必须同时有 CARD-01 能力验收事实、正式 main/release 发布标识、正式入口实际消费证据三者。

nodes.label: FR-PRD-001..003：build-prd 六步执行与 succeeded/failed 终止
nodes.norm_label: fr-prd-001..003:build-prd 六步执行与 succeeded/failed 终止
nodes.rationale: 六步完成责任齐备才可 succeeded，产出与执行事实写入任务追踪记录后规划任务收口；失败记 failed 可重入失败步但不得转入代码阶段；不改变六步内容与内部质量要求。

nodes.label: FR-TYPE / FR-TOPO：受控值类型声明与两条静态拓扑
nodes.norm_label: fr-type / fr-topo:受控值类型声明与两条静态拓扑
nodes.rationale: 任务建立后由人在 make-decision 声明一次类型，允许值恰为 规划任务/普通任务；缺失/重复/冲突/非法返回无法识别且只暂停依赖类型的分支；禁止从体量、文本、文件名、历史或哈希推断。

nodes.label: 产品边界接口蓝图（10 条接口 × 输入/输出/失败语义/consumer）
nodes.norm_label: 产品边界接口蓝图(10 条接口 × 输入/输出/失败语义/consumer)
nodes.rationale: 冻结后续卡可消费的窄接口（正式入口、类型→拓扑、正式/portable 身份、七值状态、材料归属、推进/完成分离、人工边界、审查重派），使 CARD-02..10 在冻结接口上施工；测试夹具直调不得冒充真实入口。

nodes.label: T001/T002 拓扑投影 RED→GREEN
nodes.rationale: 四对 RED/GREEN reciprocal：同 Phase/FR/AC/gate_cmd/oracle identity/evidence path，GREEN 依赖 RED，每卡恰一个完成区作为唯一完成权威。

nodes.label: T003/T004 portable 执行链 RED→GREEN
nodes.rationale: 六步执行链与 succeeded/failed 终止语义的 RED 先于 GREEN；负例（缺步/形状非法/终态后无代码阶段）在 GREEN 后保留。

nodes.norm_label: t005/t006 cohort 冻结与七值终态记录 red→green
nodes.rationale: bootstrap stamp cohort、标记缺失⇒pre、晚声明/暂停不改写 cohort、终态七值记录与历史追加不覆盖。

nodes.norm_label: t007/t008/t009 去门禁、蓝图公开与最终 aggregate 验收
nodes.rationale: T009 是唯一最终 acceptance 卡，聚合全部 23 条 AC 且每条恰好一次断言；STOP 条件为谓词被删除（而非退出路径）、出现第三类人为门、蓝图事实升级为 gate 或需改动正式阶段名单。

nodes.label: D3 当前材料决定推进，质量事实决定完成质量
nodes.norm_label: d3 当前材料决定推进,质量事实决定完成质量

nodes.label: D4 增加基线行为证据（baseline golden evidence）
nodes.norm_label: d4 增加基线行为证据(baseline golden evidence)

nodes.label: D5 保留质量平面，删除控制平面
nodes.norm_label: d5 保留质量平面,删除控制平面

nodes.label: D6 提交与清理不属于阶段确认
nodes.norm_label: d6 提交与清理不属于阶段确认

nodes.norm_label: docs/architecture/move-map.json 目录迁移唯一事实

nodes.norm_label: fr-rules-001 治理边界固化到规则/宪法/checklist/术语

nodes.norm_label: fr-safety-001 正式写入的身份绑定与原子写 fail-loud

nodes.label: FR-STAGE-001 五阶段围绕同一组四材料完成职责
nodes.norm_label: fr-stage-001 五阶段围绕同一组四材料完成职责
nodes.rationale: 失败和修订留在同一 task，不创建 successor、replacement、reopen、rebind、continuation 或 recovery 流程节点；五阶段完成谓词只决定能否如实声称业务结论，不是编辑许可。

nodes.label: FR-STORAGE-001 最小 task_dir（identity/facts/quality/index）

nodes.norm_label: pfact-runtime 基线正式执行仍有 legacy writer / vnext 边界(unknown)

nodes.norm_label: phase 0–7 依赖与产品退出条件

nodes.label: consumer-scan-proof.v1 与 publication_generation

nodes.label: workflow-evolution.mjs 单一深模块 (M16 data-plane)

nodes.norm_label: framed append-only ledger 与 batch_abort 恢复

nodes.label: project_lock 契约 (host_id/boot_id/session_epoch)

nodes.label: stage-reflection v2 six-block judgment protocol
nodes.rationale: Reflection is a non-blocking judgment layer (judgment != fact) that never becomes a quality verdict, gate or second state machine; it feeds the existing public run --action=reflect route.

nodes.label: Unavailable review is recorded honestly, not turned into pass
nodes.norm_label: unavailable review is recorded honestly, not turned into pass
nodes.rationale: Provider unavailability must remain a visible unavailable fact instead of being upgraded to a passing quality result, so missing evidence is never claimed as completion.

nodes.label: Five-stage current-material contract: pointer-only Phase index
nodes.norm_label: five-stage current-material contract: pointer-only phase index
nodes.rationale: phases/index.md must be a pure pointer index (authority ref, semantic anchor, write set, dependency, consumer) rather than a second completion ledger, so completion authority stays in task facts.

nodes.label: 按工作类型派子代理 section citing AGENTS.md as single source
nodes.norm_label: 按工作类型派子代理 section citing agents.md as single source
nodes.rationale: Each stage SKILL must cite AGENTS.md instead of restating delegation rules, so one authority governs dispatch-by-work-type and the five stage skills cannot drift apart.

nodes.label: Subagent output contract (先落盘 / 只回摘要 / 按子问题增量)
nodes.norm_label: subagent output contract (先落盘 / 只回摘要 / 按子问题增量)
nodes.rationale: Heavy work runs in subagent context and only a summary returns to the main context, keeping the工头 context small and preventing full-context inheritance between parent and child agents.

nodes.label: CONTEXT.md glossary: 子代理 as sole execution-role vocabulary
nodes.norm_label: context.md glossary: 子代理 as sole execution-role vocabulary
nodes.rationale: The glossary keeps one term (子代理) for the execution role so that post-cohort material, stage skills and facts do not silently fork into competing vocabularies such as Phase 执行者.

nodes.label: P0 foundation inventory two-way coverage with five manifests
nodes.norm_label: p0 foundation inventory two-way coverage with five manifests

nodes.label: Retire five root progress files into docs/archive/retired-root-progress
nodes.norm_label: retire five root progress files into docs/archive/retired-root-progress
nodes.rationale: Root progress files such as HANDOFF-make-decision-card07.md must move to a read-only archive so that specs/<task-id>/ stays the only progress authority.

nodes.label: verify-code manifest must declare architect-code-review and finalize-code-review
nodes.norm_label: verify-code manifest must declare architect-code-review and finalize-code-review

nodes.label: verify-code canonical review binding derivation
nodes.rationale: Repair reviews must come from an authenticated OCR provider result or an eligible Architect fallback; a non-OCR current-session review may never be marked resolved, keeping cross-source review integrity.

nodes.label: Phase as sole engineering authority, tasks as pure execution index
nodes.norm_label: phase as sole engineering authority, tasks as pure execution index
nodes.rationale: spec-plan must name the phase file the single phase engineering authority and the task list a pure execution index, so the material set has exactly one engineering body.

nodes.label: checkSkillClosure repository closure (distribution gate)
nodes.rationale: build-code and verify-code prompts reference architect-code-review and use a forbidden external/user-local skill locator, so the portable release closure cannot be closed until the skill is declared and shipped with the bundle.

nodes.label: ORACLE-SKL-001: skill bundles keep only a runtime aggregate digest
nodes.norm_label: oracle-skl-001: skill bundles keep only a runtime aggregate digest
nodes.rationale: Dropping per-file sha256 from 39 skill-bundle.json files keeps one recomputable aggregate digest that matches catalog local_bundle_hash, so closure stays verifiable without per-file hash duplication.

nodes.label: ORACLE-SKL-002: retire old plan/tasks templates, keep phase/index templates
nodes.norm_label: oracle-skl-002: retire old plan/tasks templates, keep phase/index templates
nodes.rationale: plan-template.md and tasks-template.md must be deleted and their test references removed, while the index template must expose the provider-recognized Execution Index heading so the projection still parses it.

nodes.label: ORACLE-DISP-002: phase template declares work-package fact fields
nodes.norm_label: oracle-disp-002: phase template declares work-package fact fields
nodes.rationale: The phase-file.v1 template must state interface symbols, merge responsibility and progress_cursor as fact records that never block dispatch, and must point at the AGENTS.md dispatch discipline instead of inventing a new gate.

nodes.label: progress_cursor as pointer to facts.jsonl phase_progress
nodes.norm_label: progress_cursor as pointer to facts.jsonl phase_progress
nodes.rationale: The cursor only locates where to resume; it stores no progress values, proves no completion and blocks nothing, so the single progress authority remains the facts.jsonl row.

nodes.label: Business-case catalog binds stable anchors, not whole-file sha256
nodes.norm_label: business-case catalog binds stable anchors, not whole-file sha256
nodes.rationale: Binding a case to a stable section anchor means an edit outside the anchored section keeps the case bound while losing the anchor breaks it; whole-file sha256 is too coarse and forced false staleness.

nodes.label: ORACLE-RT-001: phase write set instead of whole-tree snapshot
nodes.norm_label: oracle-rt-001: phase write set instead of whole-tree snapshot
nodes.rationale: Receipts must stay current across unrelated-file changes but fail on a declared write-set change, replacing whole-tree snapshots with a declared write set so cross-phase work is not invalidated wholesale.

nodes.label: ORACLE-RT-002: stage-runtime run no longer accepts review_budget
nodes.norm_label: oracle-rt-002: stage-runtime run no longer accepts review_budget
nodes.rationale: Removing review_budget from allowedRunFields matches the deletion of review-budget controls: identical material is not redispatched, changed material is, and direct OCR runs need no host identity or retry controls.

nodes.label: allowHistoricalPartialCoverage flag must be removed
nodes.rationale: The historical flag would still let a historical review release partial coverage; removing it is a source-side RED independent of the host_provider change.

nodes.label: host_provider is no longer a caller input
nodes.norm_label: host_provider is no longer a caller input
nodes.rationale: The old case asserting rejection of an unresolvable host_provider was inverted because host_provider is no longer a caller input; a request without it must dispatch and record normally, and the literal 'host_provider is required' must disappear from the route and runners.

nodes.label: ORACLE-REV-001 review request precheck, bad results and packet narrowing
nodes.norm_label: oracle-rev-001 review request precheck, bad results and packet narrowing
nodes.rationale: A review request must be rejected before any attempt exists (out-of-semantic-field material keys, unresolvable host_provider), a malformed provider result must be recorded as unavailable with a reason and not redispatched, and the packet must narrow to declared write set ∩ real diff without binding identity.

nodes.label: ORACLE-REV-002 partial coverage and same-triple reuse
nodes.norm_label: oracle-rev-002 partial coverage and same-triple reuse

nodes.norm_label: p4-t008 red facts after the host_provider fix

nodes.label: Amazon PR/FAQ（Working Backwards）
nodes.rationale: 问题段落必填且必须从客户视角写，并给出硬性丢弃规则：从公司现有能力倒推写出的新闻稿「should be discarded before even writing an FAQ」——最贵的成本不是问错问题，而是把用户提的方案当需求收集。

nodes.label: Claude Code 访谈式澄清（不限量访谈型）
nodes.norm_label: claude code 访谈式澄清(不限量访谈型)
nodes.rationale: 「Keep interviewing until we've covered everything」，无提问上限；官方自述 plan mode adds overhead、「If you could describe the diff in one sentence, skip the plan」——是「无上限访谈」形态的一手先例，同时自带快路径。

nodes.label: Design Council Double Diamond — Discover
nodes.rationale: 第一颗菱形「understand, rather than simply assume, what the problem is」；Design Council 自己否证线性读法：「Making and testing very early stage ideas can be part of discovery」。

nodes.label: Toyota 5 Whys（无限追问型）
nodes.rationale: 发明者为 Sakichi Toyoda、Ohno 是记述者；原始用途不是根因分析（Card 2017 批评为「策略的误用」）；丰田官方把「到现场看（genchi genbutsu）」当作方法本体，Minoura 2003 一手批评是「用演绎代替现场观察导致原因过多无法分辨」，而非 Wikipedia 转述的「太基础」。

nodes.label: 编造需求与可追溯性（hallucinated requirements）
nodes.norm_label: 编造需求与可追溯性(hallucinated requirements)
nodes.rationale: 含糊需求产生 127 个测试用例中 68% 含需求未述假设（清晰需求仅 12%）；24.7% 需求决策未被利益相关者授权。该失效模式的可操作化定义就是可追溯性（「does not trace to the explicit requirement」）。

nodes.label: Impact × Uncertainty 提问排序启发式
nodes.norm_label: impact × uncertainty 提问排序启发式
nodes.rationale: 按话题顺序提问会让低影响项挤掉高影响项，故按影响×不确定度选 top 5；且不预先泄露问题队列，防止用户一次性作答等于没问。

nodes.label: JTBD（functional/social/emotional 三分）
nodes.rationale: 官方口径明确「Jobs is not asking why someone made their decision」——以叙事式回溯访谈替代 5 Whys 式连续追问；内部存在 Ulwick/Strategyn 的 core functional job 与 desired outcomes 分歧，且 Strategyn 属党派来源。

nodes.label: Kiro Analyze Requirements（跨需求歧义猎取）
nodes.norm_label: kiro analyze requirements(跨需求歧义猎取)
nodes.rationale: 专抓五类：逻辑不一致、含糊、冲突约束、未述假设、缺失边界；每题附涉及需求、白话解释与可选建议修复，用户可把「有意的歧义」标记跳过——不是所有歧义都是缺陷。

nodes.label: 过度澄清（over-clarification）失效模式
nodes.rationale: 被点名的可测成本：open-weight backbone 平均 8.71 问/任务（校准差）；GPT-5.2 含提问 trial 中 38% 属 over-clarification；permissive prompt 下 88% 的提问是 style-preference 摸底；且已有模型-策略组合都无法在「过度问」与「静默默认」两轴同时校准。

nodes.label: 痛点优先澄清（先澄清问题再发散）
nodes.norm_label: 痛点优先澄清(先澄清问题再发散)
nodes.rationale: 方法论上是主流共识，但没有任何主流方法论把它写成「澄清完再冻结」的线性单行道；支持侧最强证据来自 LLM/代码生成领域，经典管理文献侧证据链更弱；与反证张力同时成立，一手来源的调和方式是交织而非门式。

nodes.label: GitHub Spec Kit /clarify 提问规程
nodes.norm_label: github spec kit /clarify 提问规程
nodes.rationale: 全会话最多 5 问、一次 EXACTLY ONE 问、按 Impact×Uncertainty 排序、必须可选项化或 ≤5 词短答、答案即时写回 spec 并留 Q→A 痕迹；设硬上限是为强制按影响度排序并避免「问到哪算哪」。

nodes.label: 不可引用清单（伪托与被取代的引语）
nodes.norm_label: 不可引用清单(伪托与被取代的引语)
nodes.rationale: 爱因斯坦「55 分钟定义问题」与福特「更快的马」均为伪托；CB Insights 42% 已被自家新版（第 2 原因 35%）取代；IAG「68% 项目因需求不佳失败」是扭曲的供应商白皮书数字——诚实标注优先于凑证据。

nodes.label: Rittel & Webber 恶性问题（最强反证）
nodes.norm_label: rittel & webber 恶性问题(最强反证)
nodes.rationale: 对 wicked problems「理解问题所需的信息取决于你打算怎么解决它」「问题在找到解之前无法被定义」——唯一在逻辑层面否证「先澄清再发散」普适性的论据；但原作者自带边界（只针对 wicked）与出路（argumentative process 的交织，而非跳过澄清）。

nodes.label: Brainwriting 6-3-5
nodes.rationale: 6 人 × 3 想法 × 5 分钟轮转 6 次共 108 槽位，只写不改，用于消除口头 brainstorming 的 production blocking；代价是轮转协调与书面表达门槛。

nodes.label: 发散技法＝可替换的搜索算子
nodes.norm_label: 发散技法=可替换的搜索算子
nodes.rationale: SCAMPER / 形态分析 / TRIZ / 类比迁移 / 随机刺激 / 约束移除各自只改变候选生成方向，没有任何技法在受控比较中稳定压倒其它；真正更强的证据来自组合与约束类干预而非单一技法。

nodes.label: MAP-Elites / Quality-Diversity 覆盖度
nodes.rationale: 把 illumination/coverage 本身当作目标：候选落在设计空间网格的格点数；是「覆盖度是否仍在上升」这一停止信号的可计算形式，但需要预先定义变化轴，轴错则判据失效。

nodes.label: 形态分析（Zwicky 形态箱）
nodes.rationale: 与 Quality-Diversity 同属唯一天然产出「覆盖度」的家族：先显式定义变化维度再要求组合被填充，覆盖度可被直接计算；代价是组合爆炸与轴不独立。

nodes.label: 名义群体技术（Nominal Group Technique）
nodes.norm_label: 名义群体技术(nominal group technique)
nodes.rationale: 个人先独立静默产出 → 汇总 → 讨论/投票；混合结构在产生数量、质量与质量辨识力上都优于纯团队，且「在他人点子上搭建」被报告为适得其反——个人独立产出＋事后聚合是两类文献中稳健的强基线。

nodes.label: SCAMPER（七变换算子）
nodes.rationale: 强依赖被变换对象，易产出浅层变体，对「从零起」的空白问题弱——最适合已有原型或用户已给候选时的扩增。

nodes.label: 不可引用清单（R2）
nodes.rationale: 「群体比个人少产 50% 想法」「让 LLM 再想 10 个能显著提升新颖性」「24 种选项导致购买率下降 X%」等均未取得可核对一手出处；检索工具全配额 402，所有一手校验改由 OpenAlex/Crossref/arXiv/Europe PMC 公开 API 完成。

nodes.label: R2 发散的方法与质量 — 外部调研
nodes.norm_label: r2 发散的方法与质量 — 外部调研

nodes.label: Ambig-SWE（欠指定下的交互式澄清）
nodes.norm_label: ambig-swe(欠指定下的交互式澄清)
nodes.rationale: 交互式澄清带来最高 74% 性能提升；同时证明模型「struggle to distinguish between well-specified and underspecified instructions」，且提问量高不等于收益高（6.02 问/任务并不更好）。

nodes.label: Artificial Hivemind（模型间想法同质）
nodes.rationale: 79% 情况下平均相似度超 0.8，模型间相似度 71%–82%，换多样性解码也压不下去——规模最大的「同源起点导致趋同」证据，直接削弱「多问/多生成就更发散」的推论。

nodes.label: Ask or Assume?（不确定性感知澄清策略）
nodes.norm_label: ask or assume?(不确定性感知澄清策略)
nodes.rationale: scaffold 达 69.40% resolve rate，但在其选择不问的 156 个任务上仍有 76.92%，与「不能问」基线 77.56% 持平——同时证明「几乎每次都问」的基线是以 over-clarification 为代价换来的。

nodes.label: Boehm & Basili「100 倍」及其被删掉的例外
nodes.norm_label: boehm & basili「100 倍」及其被删掉的例外
nodes.rationale: 原文自带 5:1 例外并明确支持需求涌现（emergency processes、requirements emerge from prototyping）；被广泛当作「先澄清」弹药的这条经典引用其实是残缺/漂移的。

nodes.label: ClarifyGPT（澄清带来的对照提升）
nodes.rationale: GPT-4 在 MBPP-sanitized Pass@1 70.96%→80.80%，是「先澄清」最强的量化证据；但同文把提问当有代价资源，警告 unnecessary interactions 会降低效率与体验。

nodes.label: Sycophancy（迎合式回答与压力下改口）
nodes.norm_label: sycophancy(迎合式回答与压力下改口)
nodes.rationale: 「Are you sure?」使 Claude 1.3 在 98% 问题上错误承认犯错、准确率最多降 27%；人类偏好模型 95% 概率偏好迎合式回答。含义：每个「确认一下对吗」都是用户覆盖模型正确立场的机会，而用户主动提出的方案正是模型被训练去附和的前提。

nodes.label: 锚定效应与发散产物呈现形态
nodes.norm_label: 锚定效应与发散产物呈现形态
nodes.rationale: 调整通常不充分且在「看起来合理」处停止，故任何「第一个/最佳」的呈现都构成锚；低任务专长者不会折扣 AI 建议，且 ChatGPT 用户对点子责任感更低——呈现形态不仅影响判断，也影响「谁觉得这是自己的决定」。

nodes.label: Artificial Hivemind（R2 侧同质化证据）
nodes.norm_label: artificial hivemind(r2 侧同质化证据)
nodes.rationale: 26K 真实开放式查询 + 31,250 条人工标注确认 intra-model repetition 与 inter-model homogeneity 同时存在；作者主张长期同质化是 AI 安全风险。

nodes.label: Choice overload（选项过多的元分析反证）
nodes.norm_label: choice overload(选项过多的元分析反证)
nodes.rationale: 63 个条件 / 50 个实验 / N=5,036，平均效应量近乎为零且无法确定充分条件——「选项太多必然损害决策」不成立，因此不存在普适的候选数量上限；经典果酱研究在元分析中未能稳定复现。

nodes.label: Doshi & Hauser：个体创造力↑、集体多样性↓
nodes.norm_label: doshi & hauser:个体创造力↑、集体多样性↓
nodes.rationale: 使用 AI 点子后故事彼此更相似（b=0.871 / 0.718），相当于人类相似度全距的 10.7% / 8.9%，同时个体质量上升——作者框架为「社会困境」：个体理性导致集体收窄。

nodes.label: 多智能体 debate 抑制跨会话多样性
nodes.norm_label: 多智能体 debate 抑制跨会话多样性
nodes.rationale: Homo MAD 语义多样性低于单智能体基线；Proposition 1 证明会话内 agent 多样性是跨会话输出多样性的必要条件；「Voting 多样性≈Direct」把收敛归因于 debate 动态本身而非共识机制——质量层与多样性层结论并存不矛盾。

nodes.label: Persona prompting 对客观任务无增益
nodes.norm_label: persona prompting 对客观任务无增益
nodes.rationale: 162 个角色 × 2,410 个事实问题上加 persona 相对无 persona 不提升表现，自动挑最佳 persona 常常不如随机选；若目的是覆盖度，应把它当多样性干预而非质量干预。

nodes.label: Production blocking（群体产出损失机制）
nodes.norm_label: production blocking(群体产出损失机制)
nodes.rationale: 群体产出低于同人数个人之和，归因于 social loafing/free riding、evaluation apprehension、production blocking；工业界大规模复现显示个人在 originality/feasibility/effectiveness 上显著更好——「过程满意度高」不等于「产出高」。

nodes.label: 采样温度不是发散杠杆
nodes.norm_label: 采样温度不是发散杠杆
nodes.rationale: 9 个 LLM × 5 种提示法，温度 0.0–1.0 内对解题表现无统计显著影响；要发散应改 prompt 结构（Verbalized Sampling、异构视角），而不是调温度旋钮。

nodes.label: Verbalized Sampling（口述分布式采样）
nodes.rationale: 把 mode collapse 归因于偏好数据的 typicality bias——在完美 reward model 与完美优化下仍会发生；让模型口述响应分布及概率可提升创意写作多样性 1.6–2.1×、人评 +25.7%，且事实性与安全性不降。

nodes.label: Material Identity Algorithm
nodes.rationale: The identity algorithm aligns WH and BR over the same semantic material set, excludes wrapper records, and preserves deterministic UTF-8 byte ordering.

nodes.label: Explicit Fact Ledger
nodes.rationale: P3 turns unanchored findings, unknown keys or severities, and stage-analyze skips into explicit facts without adding a second control plane.

nodes.label: No-cancel Cases
nodes.rationale: Cancellation is narrowly tied to observed source drift; wall-clock waits, temporary status errors, normal terminals, and member failure remain non-cancel paths.

nodes.label: Digest Two-axis Split
nodes.rationale: Digest splitting is stopped until producer, consumer, and historical compatibility are authoritative; no second summary or wire field is invented.

nodes.label: Phase Review Unavailable
nodes.rationale: Provider review incompatibility remains unavailable/incomplete and must not be rewritten as a quality pass.

nodes.label: capability spike：进入 build-code 前必须完成的真实小实验
nodes.norm_label: capability spike:进入 build-code 前必须完成的真实小实验
nodes.rationale: 先证明当前 host 能不能真的产生 step/skill 的开始、结束、usage 和证据，任一失败即记录缺口并保持 M15 未完成，避免用整轮 token、平均分配、模板或旧记录替代。

nodes.label: D-001 记录链与 M15 页面契约一起交付
nodes.norm_label: d-001 记录链与 m15 页面契约一起交付
nodes.rationale: 数据链与消费端必须一起验收，才能交付可核实的 M15，而不是只交一个 producer 或空页面；只修记录链会留下页面缺口，把 M16 一起做会混淆交付边界。

nodes.label: D-002 按真实能力交付，不猜宿主事件
nodes.norm_label: d-002 按真实能力交付,不猜宿主事件
nodes.rationale: 生产 caller 尚未证明覆盖所有宿主事件，不能把原字段清单当事实；先验证能力并分层声明，避免再次交付“字段存在但没有数据”的假完整看板。

nodes.label: D-003 先验证根因再决定修复动作
nodes.norm_label: d-003 先验证根因再决定修复动作
nodes.rationale: 独立审查指出原始文字含未证实前提，且用户要求先检查；把根因验证置于修复之前可避免错误修复和错误诊断，同时不拆成两个 WorkflowHub 任务。

nodes.label: D-004 基础链可交付，宿主细节保持诚实缺失
nodes.norm_label: d-004 基础链可交付,宿主细节保持诚实缺失
nodes.rationale: 基础事实可交付、不可证明的细节保持缺失，M15 就不被宿主未承诺接口整体卡死，也不产生假数据；宿主细节缺失就整体不交付会把基础链一起卡死。

nodes.label: D-005 M15 必须交付真实 step/skill 事实
nodes.norm_label: d-005 m15 必须交付真实 step/skill 事实
nodes.rationale: 用户核心问题是无法确认真实执行（页面显示 0/63 steps、0/30 skills），只有真实 step/skill 证据才能确认，所以必须修入口和事件链，页面只消费可回指事实。

nodes.label: D-006 正式入口负责发出 step/skill 上下文
nodes.norm_label: d-006 正式入口负责发出 step/skill 上下文
nodes.rationale: 外部 outcome producer 未接通，继续依赖外部模板会复现空看板；正式入口先产生稳定上下文，host adapter 才能把真实 usage 绑定到正确对象，页面才能显示可核实结果。

nodes.label: D-007 真实 WorkflowHub run 才是验收起点
nodes.norm_label: d-007 真实 workflowhub run 才是验收起点
nodes.rationale: bridge 只转交外部结果，runner 也不启动 host，绕过真实 run 就无法证明任务执行；以真实 run 作为唯一验收起点可堵住“只调用 bridge/只加载页面却宣称接入”的漏洞。

nodes.label: 证据最小合同：evidence_ref、source 版本、内容 hash 与可读性
nodes.norm_label: 证据最小合同:evidence_ref、source 版本、内容 hash 与可读性
nodes.rationale: 只有编号和内容都能核对才算有证据，防止系统用一个看似正规的编号掩盖事实链断裂；通用模板、目录名或旧任务记录都不算证据。

nodes.label: Grill 收口：每次执行唯一编号、成本只计一次、缺失不显示为 0
nodes.norm_label: grill 收口:每次执行唯一编号、成本只计一次、缺失不显示为 0
nodes.rationale: 只有每次执行唯一绑定、失败重试保留、分母来自任务自己的清单、同一笔 token 只算一次，页面才不会被错误数据带偏，也才能为 M16 提供可靠事实。

nodes.label: 方案 A：同一真实 Codex 会话贯穿五个阶段并复用同一 source 绑定
nodes.norm_label: 方案 a:同一真实 codex 会话贯穿五个阶段并复用同一 source 绑定
nodes.rationale: fresh M15 run 显示只有 make-decision 的 source 为 present，后四阶段为 no_registered_source，说明主要缺口是来源在阶段切换时丢失；手工重注册或从旧 transcript 猜测会再次制造看似完整但无法核对的页面。

nodes.label: 页面状态与既有事实状态的唯一派生映射
nodes.norm_label: 页面状态与既有事实状态的唯一派生映射

nodes.label: DEC-A 复用现有 stage-runtime sidecar
nodes.norm_label: dec-a 复用现有 stage-runtime sidecar
nodes.rationale: 它已经是唯一同时拥有 task context、stage outcome、TaskStore、projector 和 global rebuild 的生产位置；把 M10/M14b collector 接成并行 writer 或新增 monitoring service 会产生第二条写入路径。

nodes.label: DEC-B 事实九状态，页面六状态
nodes.norm_label: dec-b 事实九状态,页面六状态
nodes.rationale: 原始事实必须保留“未发生、合法跳过、不可用、不支持、冲突、不完整”的区别；把 partial/fatal 写进事实会混淆根因和页面可用性。

nodes.label: DEC-C 固定视图字段和分母
nodes.norm_label: dec-c 固定视图字段和分母
nodes.rationale: 页面不能用“有几条记录”猜覆盖率；没有分母或字段身份时，正确答案是 insufficient/unknown。

nodes.label: DEC-E 未证明当前会话能力保持缺失状态
nodes.norm_label: dec-e 未证明当前会话能力保持缺失状态
nodes.rationale: 当前正常会话没有证明的自动 source/step/skill caller，把 fixture 或用户手工启动当生产接入会复现 M15 的根因；某些 fresh 页面可能是 partial，但这是真实能力边界。

nodes.label: DEC-F 正常会话自动提交结果，runtime 只认证和落盘
nodes.norm_label: dec-f 正常会话自动提交结果,runtime 只认证和落盘
nodes.rationale: 用户真正使用的是当前会话；只补会话接线、复用窄的 stage-agent-outcome-adapter，既绕不开真实入口也不违反薄核心边界。

nodes.label: fresh 证明与删除派生物后重建（facts hash 不变）
nodes.norm_label: fresh 证明与删除派生物后重建(facts hash 不变)

nodes.label: Phase 1 — 正式入口与 canonical facts
nodes.norm_label: phase 1 — 正式入口与 canonical facts
nodes.rationale: 成功、失败和缺 outcome 三条路径都必须先 initializeTaskStore 再调 sidecar，否则成功 run 可能没有 canonical facts store；没有真实事件时记录 unknown/unavailable，不把 topology 当执行清单。

nodes.label: Phase 2 — projection、诊断与四区页面
nodes.rationale: 让数据 contract 先于页面：sample sufficiency 的分母与 required fields 必须由 projection 提供，不能让 HTML 自行计数或把缺失字段显示为零。

nodes.label: Phase 3 — 正常会话自动 outcome 与正式验收
nodes.norm_label: phase 3 — 正常会话自动 outcome 与正式验收
nodes.rationale: 把结果交给一个需要另外启动的 Stage Agent 会继续绕开真实入口，在 runtime 内启动 Agent 又违反薄核心边界，所以只补会话接线，不增加第二个 Agent 或第二个 writer。

nodes.label: 方案 A 修正：按精确 session_id 定位的临时 handoff 索引
nodes.norm_label: 方案 a 修正:按精确 session_id 定位的临时 handoff 索引
nodes.rationale: 让同一 Codex 会话在阶段切换、cwd 变化或不同 CLI 进程间复用同一 source binding；索引只存位置不复制事件，唯一 consumer 是 stage-runtime 与私有 session event，SessionEnd 清理时失效。

nodes.label: AC-012 五阶段 source identity 回指同一条绑定
nodes.norm_label: ac-012 五阶段 source identity 回指同一条绑定
nodes.rationale: 失败条件包括只有第一阶段有 source、后续阶段重新猜 source、需要用户重复输入、启动额外 Agent、跨 task 串数据或 source 丢失后仍显示阶段完成。

nodes.label: 锁定的 Expected topology 基线（五阶段 + manifest order + skill-deps）
nodes.norm_label: 锁定的 expected topology 基线(五阶段 + manifest order + skill-deps)
nodes.rationale: 流程退化只能与已确认基线比较；顺序只在同一 run_id+attempt_id 内按 manifest order 判断，未来阶段是 pending，只有观察到更后阶段却缺更前阶段才是 evidence_gap。

nodes.label: 九种事实状态（present/missing/skipped/not_applicable/unknown/unavailable/unsupported/conflict/incomplete）
nodes.rationale: 诊断中的 pending/evidence_gap/out_of_order/failed 只能是带 reason 的派生结果；不把 unknown、unavailable、unsupported、incomplete 算作流程退化。

nodes.label: FR-CHAIN-003 第一阶段自动创建一次 source binding，后续阶段复用
nodes.norm_label: fr-chain-003 第一阶段自动创建一次 source binding,后续阶段复用
nodes.rationale: 绑定不存在、切换 task 或来源身份不一致时阶段入口必须失败并留下 incomplete/unavailable 原因，避免把该阶段写成有完整来源的成功记录。

nodes.label: FR-E2E-001 fresh Codex 任务贯通入口→facts→投影→浏览器
nodes.norm_label: fr-e2e-001 fresh codex 任务贯通入口→facts→投影→浏览器
nodes.rationale: 不要求每类宿主事件都为 present，但要求每类都有诚实状态；不能用文件存在、API 返回或页面字符串替代中间绑定和浏览器验收。

nodes.label: FR-VIEW-001 四区页面与七类共享筛选
nodes.norm_label: fr-view-001 四区页面与七类共享筛选

nodes.label: PFACT-008 宿主事件能力尚未证明（status unknown）
nodes.norm_label: pfact-008 宿主事件能力尚未证明(status unknown)

nodes.label: RISK-005 阶段切换时 source handoff 仍可能丢失
nodes.norm_label: risk-005 阶段切换时 source handoff 仍可能丢失
nodes.rationale: 入口缺绑定就直接失败并保留 incomplete/unavailable，不使用目录扫描或历史回填；五阶段 source 未全部闭合时 M15 不得 close。

nodes.label: PFACT-007 样本充分性（sufficient/insufficient/empty_valid/unknown）
nodes.rationale: 按视图所需字段覆盖、任务范围和 time-window 判断，不足时不能以 0 或 false 代替；它不是质量评分。

nodes.label: SCN-011 同一真实来源贯穿五个阶段
nodes.norm_label: scn-011 同一真实来源贯穿五个阶段

nodes.label: 六种页面状态（loading/ready/empty_valid/partial/stale/fatal）
nodes.rationale: 页面状态和事实状态不互相替代：partial/stale 仍可展示可用事实但不能伪装成 ready，fatal 不显示未经验证的数字。

nodes.label: M15 真实记录链与看板交付修复 — decision log
nodes.norm_label: m15 真实记录链与看板交付修复 — decision log

nodes.label: M15 真实记录链与看板交付修复 — 工程计划 (plan-task.v3)
nodes.norm_label: m15 真实记录链与看板交付修复 — 工程计划 (plan-task.v3)

nodes.label: 功能规格：M15 真实记录链与看板交付修复 (spec-content.v3)
nodes.norm_label: 功能规格:m15 真实记录链与看板交付修复 (spec-content.v3)

nodes.label: External Capture Script
nodes.source_location: §Technical Context; §项目文件结构; §验证策略

nodes.label: Core Boundary Rule core/**/*.mjs
nodes.rationale: A single machine-readable core/**/*.mjs boundary is reused by anti-host checks, diff checks, and omission self-tests to prevent scope drift.

nodes.label: Path Guard Single Entry
nodes.rationale: All path resolution must use one entry point and reject working-directory inference, host-root traversal, and host-derived layouts.

nodes.label: Thin Dispatch Core
nodes.rationale: The core reads configuration, locates and invokes black-box components, and returns structured results without embedding business-stage branches.

nodes.label: Metrics Collector Pipeline
nodes.rationale: The metrics foundation uses one collector, three update timings, execution records, knowledge cards, baseline aggregation, and CI smoke checks while preserving the record-only rule.
nodes.source_location: §项目文件结构; §Data Model; §验证策略

nodes.label: Quality Gate Zero
nodes.rationale: M5 preserves quality-blocking count at zero: facts are recorded, boundary states are observed, and prevention relies on falsifiable scans rather than a runtime quality gate.
nodes.source_location: 验收清单; 覆盖核对

nodes.label: Quality Observation Layer
nodes.rationale: M5 turns quality into zero-cost facts, structured three-state confirmation, non-blocking boundary handling, and inspectable failure propagation instead of a runtime blocking mechanism.

nodes.label: TDD Red Green Loop
nodes.rationale: RED and GREEN must be established from external process signals, hashes, and durable evidence; implementers cannot self-report test truth.

nodes.label: D-015 阶段顺序与真实测试路由 revision
nodes.norm_label: d-015 阶段顺序与真实测试路由 revision

nodes.label: D-016 P1—P5 统一为 review fact + finding disposition
nodes.norm_label: d-016 p1—p5 统一为 review fact + finding disposition

nodes.label: D-017 verify-code 有限审查顺序
nodes.norm_label: d-017 verify-code 有限审查顺序

nodes.label: Phase P1 受控当前材料与 Grill/技能事实边界
nodes.norm_label: phase p1 受控当前材料与 grill/技能事实边界
nodes.rationale: make-decision 必须把 decision-log 写入受控 specs/<task>/ 并由后续阶段读取同一 ArtifactDir，避免出现第二份材料真相；根目录同名文件不再是输入。

nodes.label: Phase P2 阶段技能调用和 review advisory 语义
nodes.norm_label: phase p2 阶段技能调用和 review advisory 语义
nodes.rationale: required stage skill 必须真实 dispatch 并留下 invocation fact；review lens 由 wh-review 单一 owner 调用，非 build-code review 不循环追求 pass，普通快照变化不自动触发全量复审，以避免把质量事实当成推进许可证。

nodes.norm_label: d-001 删除评审当前性失效链,字段保留为 provenance
nodes.rationale: 失效链无宪法依据且是最大重复劳动源（一次材料修改曾丢掉约 40 分钟已完成 provider 结果）；material_digest/snapshot_tree/decision_revision 保留为 provenance 不违反 provenance 要求，因此删除比较即可，不需新机制。

nodes.norm_label: d-002 删除评审轮次预算,review_result_ref 去重先行
nodes.rationale: 预算是三大真硬阻断之一且实测把未发出的调用也算作消耗；ADR-0028 要求以『保留同等语义的经审查替代机制』才可替换，review_result_ref 同 track 去重即该替代，故必须先去重后删预算。

nodes.norm_label: d-003 唯一代码身份门槛:verify-code 终局绑当前快照
nodes.rationale: 阶段审查有 verify-code 兜底可不比快照；verify-code 之后没有下游兜底且宪法禁止把未覆盖说成通过，因此唯一门槛落在终局；代价是 build-code 集成审查声明必须按来源范围表述。

nodes.label: D-004 审查事实按来源范围呈现，不引入 stale 判定
nodes.norm_label: d-004 审查事实按来源范围呈现,不引入 stale 判定
nodes.rationale: 不显示快照会让读者误判覆盖范围，显示『过期提示』等于把失效链换名装回；靠范围化表述加 verify-code 兜底同时满足 provenance 与删失效链两条硬要求。

nodes.label: D-005 来源漂移时保留并使用已完成 provider 结果
nodes.norm_label: d-005 来源漂移时保留并使用已完成 provider 结果
nodes.rationale: 结果已存在且已付费，丢弃或整轮降级都是浪费；改动面小于分析材料估计，因为现状已把结果保留在记录里，只是发布被降级。

nodes.label: D-006 跨仓实施面与收口面拆分，只收口 workflowhub
nodes.norm_label: d-006 跨仓实施面与收口面拆分,只收口 workflowhub
nodes.rationale: task-bootstrap 只接受单个 --target-repo，任务模型只支持单仓收口；拆开实施面与收口面既满足用户『同时改两仓』的意图，又不伪造外部仓验收。

nodes.label: D-007 外部服务必须先做终止/判死原语
nodes.norm_label: d-007 外部服务必须先做终止/判死原语
nodes.rationale: 外部服务没有进度时间戳、没有单 provider 截止、配置拒绝按耗时终止、停滞只写诊断不杀进程、取消接口零调用；不做判死原语，任何熔断/达标即收敛策略都是空写。

nodes.label: D-008 满足最少异源数即产出分组结论
nodes.norm_label: d-008 满足最少异源数即产出分组结论
nodes.rationale: 空等根因是『等全终态』；改为达标即产出必须同时定义部分结果语义（运行中成员保持 running），否则消费方无法判断完备性。

nodes.label: D-009 迟到结果在有效窗口内作为追加来源合入
nodes.norm_label: d-009 迟到结果在有效窗口内作为追加来源合入
nodes.rationale: 不丢弃迟到结果但不能让它们无限延长本轮；设有效窗口（窗口内追加、窗口外标 over_window_unjudged）既不浪费已完成调用，也不把『等最慢成员』换个形式装回来。

nodes.norm_label: d-020 可证伪断言 + t3 真实计数作对照,不新跑真实任务

nodes.norm_label: d-022 run --action=execute 增加 interaction_aggregate 正式发布字段

nodes.rationale: Attempt 1 via /dev/stdin ended EAGAIN with adapter=0 and provider=0; attempt 2 ran about 21 minutes then was stopped with no terminal output. Unavailable is not a pass and no P1 or Stage completion claim is valid.

nodes.label: WH-CONSUMER Non-Terminal Member Tolerance
nodes.rationale: Consumer-side and P1-only: tolerance of non-terminal member status/error.code/last_progress_at_ms, terminal recheck and the 20-minute threshold without cancelManaged, broker unavailable/reuse facts, extra top-level keys, and attempt process_outcome/parse_outcome registration are established before P2 producers publish.

nodes.label: ORACLE-BROKER-HEALTH / 3rd-review Producer Facts
nodes.rationale: Antigravity print-timeout must classify as PROVIDER_PRINT_TIMEOUT and map to PROCESS_TIMEOUT with one-shot retry; single_round/full_only each get exactly one fresh_execution retry, and no-resume same_session_repair falls back to one fresh_execution.

nodes.label: P2 RED and GREEN Evidence (P2-red.txt / P2-green.txt)
nodes.norm_label: p2 red and green evidence (p2-red.txt / p2-green.txt)
nodes.rationale: The T003 RED run was 85 tests / 77 pass / 8 fail with seven target assertions plus one pre-existing unrelated hardening negative, so seven-redline completeness is not claimed; the historical same-command GREEN was 85/85 pass.

nodes.label: P2 Review Blocked Before Dispatch (revision mismatch)
nodes.norm_label: p2 review blocked before dispatch (revision mismatch)
nodes.rationale: The review binding used an older material revision than the current one, so the requested review files are absent and no review result exists to bind; the error is recorded as PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE rather than rewritten as a pass.

nodes.label: ORACLE-PREFLIGHT-DRIFT (preflight + source/material drift)
nodes.rationale: Illegal host_provider or invalid model/CLI/auth/probe must block before buildBundle, lock, or dispatch with dispatch_state=blocked_before_dispatch, while a runtime agy timeout stays a dispatched runtime failure; drift stops managed polling, records REVIEW_SOURCE_DRIFT, and detaches without cancelManaged.

nodes.label: P3 RED and GREEN Evidence (P3-red.txt / P3-green.txt)
nodes.norm_label: p3 red and green evidence (p3-red.txt / p3-green.txt)
nodes.rationale: Canonical RED exit=1 with 27 failed / 213 passed, of which 8 are target preflight/redispatch failures and 19 non-target later-phase failures; the paired GREEN exit=0 passed 221 tests with all 11 target cases green.

nodes.label: P4 Finding Dispositions (F-2645 / F-f188 / F-6969)
nodes.rationale: Quorum, blocked-to-failed, and private-host findings were each fixed at named file and line anchors; this is disposition-only writeback with no test or review rerun, so the fresh P4 review remains pending.

nodes.label: ORACLE-FORMAT-REDLINES and Seven Fail-Closed Redlines
nodes.rationale: Format and key tolerance must not weaken the seven fail-closed rules: host paths stay fail-closed with only blast-radius shrink, findings must anchor to submitted material and a real line, quorum and the material allowlist stay enforced, identity stays bound to provider selection, required envelope keys stay required, and non-minor findings still need evidence_kind, evidence, root_cause.

nodes.label: Format Tolerance Precedence (JSONL, fence, JSON candidate)
nodes.norm_label: format tolerance precedence (jsonl, fence, json candidate)
nodes.rationale: Deterministic precedence is JSONL over the unique findings-bearing fence over the first parseable JSON candidate; only unknown-severity findings are dropped and all-invalid candidates yield structured OUTPUT_INVALID with a parse error, so tolerance never becomes silent acceptance.

nodes.label: P4 Legal RED/GREEN (P4-red-clean.txt / P4-green-findings-fixed.txt)
nodes.rationale: Earlier RED captures including a contaminated run are retained only as provenance; the legal RED was obtained during T008 implementation isolation and the five production files were then restored byte-for-byte, so pairing is honest without promoting contaminated bytes.

nodes.label: P4 Review Unavailable (EVIDENCE_ANCHOR_INVALID)
nodes.rationale: Both provider calls failed because provider finding evidence did not anchor to submitted material; findings are empty and coverage incomplete, so review unavailable is not a pass and P4 stays incomplete.

nodes.label: ORACLE-FACT-BINDING / Two-Track Quality Fact Binding
nodes.rationale: Direction and detail review quality facts must bind only their own track result; a missing track stays missing rather than falling back across tracks through evidenceCandidate, whose cross-track fallback had treated another track's evidence as this track's fact.

nodes.label: P5 RED and GREEN Evidence (P5-red.txt / P5-green.txt)
nodes.norm_label: p5 red and green evidence (p5-red.txt / p5-green.txt)
nodes.rationale: The narrow gate ran one target assertion: RED exit=1 (1 failed / 28 skipped) then GREEN exit=0 (1 passed / 28 skipped); route dry-run failures were recorded as dry-run facts and do not substitute for the gate.

nodes.label: P5 Review Unavailable (REVIEW_WAIT_EXCEEDED)
nodes.rationale: The review waited 1,200,000 ms with broker_cancelled=false and zero provider calls, so coverage is incomplete and unavailable is not a pass; existing unknown/unavailable/partial quality semantics are preserved rather than rewritten.

nodes.label: DEF-09 Unclosed (quality-verify.v1 residue)
nodes.rationale: tests/e2e/ui-e2e-contract-dogfood.test.mjs:223 still carries schema_version "quality-verify.v1"; it may only be implemented later in build-code, so build-plan writes it into plan/tasks only.

nodes.label: P1-P8 + FINAL Implementation Phasing
nodes.rationale: Cross-repo order is forced: WorkflowHub must first tolerate non-terminal member facts before 3rd-review may produce them; never half-publish a producer before consumer compatibility. Full package-level npm test / test:safe remain forbidden.

nodes.rationale: Pins the frozen build-plan inputs: decision-log.md 1801 lines sha256 22af1df9..., spec.md 1121 lines sha256 f5ac146e..., 38 FR / 38 AC / 20 PFACT / 12 SCN.

nodes.rationale: Step 12 is the only normal human confirmation point and must come after all authored fixes and final analyze; step 9 does exactly one real independent wh-review and is not re-run merely to chase empty findings; step 13 reflection is non-blocking but mandatory.

nodes.rationale: Only six external files are writable (antigravity adapter, provider-failure, recovery-policy, broker, workflowhub-result-v3, managed-session-lifecycle test); the two config files must not change and provider dispatch must not be reduced. Test file addition was explicitly user-authorized.

nodes.rationale: Each target suite was first captured unchanged to record what actually fails (and in a few cases what already passes) before any fix, so a later GREEN claim can be compared against real prior bytes rather than a re-derived expectation.

nodes.norm_label: build-code diff scanner (scandiff irreversible_git classification removed)
nodes.rationale: The uncalled C2_IRREVERSIBLE_GIT_RULES were deleted, so build-code no longer classifies git push / push --force / reset --hard / branch -d as irreversible_git violations; the scan stays a diff fact rather than a progression gate.

nodes.label: Unified Fallback Protocol (validateFallbackProtocol across the five formal stages)
nodes.norm_label: unified fallback protocol (validatefallbackprotocol across the five formal stages)
nodes.rationale: Ownership routing replaces whole-stage reruns: implementation-level problems stay in the current stage, specification ambiguity returns to the owning authoring step (build-spec for pre, build-plan spec-clarify for post), direction-level gaps return to make-decision, and a mismatch only keeps the formal completion fact incomplete.

nodes.label: Post Material Set Scoped Per Stage (make-decision requires only decision-log.md)
nodes.norm_label: post material set scoped per stage (make-decision requires only decision-log.md)
nodes.rationale: Post cohort splits authoring: make-decision needs only decision-log.md, build-plan owns spec.md plus phases/P<n>.md and the pure pointer phases/index.md, so handoff must not throw 'post Phase index is missing' or force plan/tasks back into the current set.

nodes.label: Grouped Plan-Gap Return and Work-Loop Discipline
nodes.norm_label: grouped plan-gap return and work-loop discipline
nodes.rationale: A phase that discovers its own plan is wrong must list every gap once, stop only the affected part as blocked_by_plan_gap, and return them as one batch; the one self-report line 'what changed since last time and whether the failure signal is the same' turns an unproductive retry into a human escalation instead of silent repetition.

nodes.label: Phase Task RED Evidence (per-task failing-assertion evidence for P4/P5/P6)
nodes.norm_label: phase task red evidence (per-task failing-assertion evidence for p4/p5/p6)
nodes.rationale: RED is only valid when the named target assertion fails; collection, setup, environment or configuration failures do not count, so each Phase task stores its own raw runner output with the failing assertion and exit state.

nodes.label: Review Orchestration Module (canonical review attempt/result recording, reuse, timeout, cancellation)
nodes.norm_label: review orchestration module (canonical review attempt/result recording, reuse, timeout, cancellation)
nodes.rationale: One review seam owns abort signals, bounded dispatch cleanup, canonical attempt/result refs and same-triple reuse, so a cancelled or timed-out dispatch still settles and reaps its process group before the task lock is released instead of racing a later request.

nodes.label: test-routing-advisor (statseless route re-decision against the actual changed-file scope)
nodes.norm_label: test-routing-advisor (statseless route re-decision against the actual changed-file scope)
nodes.rationale: The plan route is only a baseline: the advisor is invoked once per behavior Phase against the real changed-file boundary, records the reroute when scope differs, and never executes tests or grants permission, which keeps the plan from becoming the test decision.

nodes.label: Unavailable / Incomplete Is Never Pass and Never a Work Blocker
nodes.norm_label: unavailable / incomplete is never pass and never a work blocker
nodes.rationale: Missing quality evidence only lowers the completion claim; rewriting a provider failure or unavailable review as a pass would hide a missing quality fact, so the fact stays visible while same-task repair and the next safe work item continue.
